items.title: The first OpenBind release: An open experimental structure-affinity dataset and benchmark for structure-based AI
items.abstract_or_text: High-quality experimental datasets that link protein-ligand structures with binding affinity data are essential for developing and evaluating structure-based machine learning methods. To help address this need, we established OpenBind as an open-science initiative to generate large-scale experimental datasets for structure-based AI and molecular discovery. Here, we describe the first public OpenBind release, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the largest public single-target experimental structure-affinity dataset. The dataset focuses on enteroviral 2A protease, comprising 925 crystallographic binding events from 699 compounds and associated affinity measurements for 601 compounds. It combines structures from an initial fragment screen and follow-on molecules, together with affinity data, linking experimentally determined protein-ligand binding modes to biophysical measurements within a coherent antiviral discovery campaign. We used this dataset to evaluate protein-ligand structure prediction, binding-affinity prediction, and virtual screening using representative structure-based methods, including docking and cofolding. This exposed several challenges that are central to practical structure-based modelling: docking performance depends strongly on binding-pocket conformation, poses are difficult to rank, and structure-based affinity prediction remains challenging. Fine-tuning OpenFold3-p2 on the fragment-screen structures substantially improved pose prediction and virtual screening for related follow-on compounds, demonstrating how early-stage experimental structures can support target-specific model adaptation.
items.summary_zh: OpenBind 首次公开了以肠道病毒2A protease为对象的蛋白—配体结构—亲和力数据集，并用其评估对接、共折叠、亲和力预测和虚拟筛选；在片段筛选结构上微调 OpenFold3-p2 可提升后续化合物的构象预测与虚拟筛选表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是稀缺的同一抗病毒项目内、结构与生物物理亲和力相连的实验数据资源，可更贴近实际药物发现地检验结构模型。数据目前限于单一靶点，文中也显示口袋构象、构象排序和亲和力预测仍是主要难题。
items.abstract_zh: 将蛋白—配体结构与结合亲和力数据相连接的高质量实验数据集，对于开发和评估基于结构的机器学习方法至关重要。为帮助解决这一需求，我们建立了 OpenBind——一项旨在为基于结构的AI和分子发现生成大规模实验数据集的开放科学倡议。这里，我们描述 OpenBind 的首次公开发布；据我们所知，这是最大的公开单靶点实验性结构—亲和力数据集。该数据集聚焦肠道病毒2A protease，包含来自699种化合物的925个晶体学结合事件，以及601种化合物对应的亲和力测量。它结合了初始片段筛选和后续化合物的结构与亲和力数据，在连贯的抗病毒发现项目中将实验确定的蛋白—配体结合模式与生物物理测量关联起来。我们利用该数据集评估了蛋白—配体结构预测、结合亲和力预测和虚拟筛选，所用代表性结构方法包括对接和共折叠。这暴露出对实际结构建模至关重要的若干挑战：对接性能强烈依赖结合口袋构象，构象难以排序，基于结构的亲和力预测依然困难。在片段筛选结构上微调 OpenFold3-p2，显著改善了相关后续化合物的构象预测和虚拟筛选，展示了早期实验结构如何支持靶点特异性的模型适配。

items.title: From Computational Chemistry to Generative Models: A Survey of AI-Driven Small-Molecule Drug Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Small-molecule drug discovery requires navigating enormous chemical space to identify candidates that are simultaneously potent, selective, synthetically accessible, and acceptable across pharmacokinetic and safety profiles; modern generative AI extends a long computational medicinal chemistry lineage that began with QSAR, pharmacophore modeling, and early structure-based de novo design. This survey focuses primarily on developments from 2017 to 2025, with the literature updated through 31 January 2026. Using a medicinal-chemistry lens, it first establishes the shared machinery of the field: molecular representations such as SMILES, SELFIES, graphs, fingerprints, three-dimensional coordinates, voxels, and latent vectors; commonly used datasets and benchmarks; and graph neural network encoders, including message-passing, directional, and equivariant architectures. We compare five principal generative mechanisms—autoregressive models, variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, normalizing flows, and diffusion models—together with reinforcement learning as a major goal-directed optimization framework. Across these approaches, we show that current methods offer complementary rather than interchangeable trade-offs, and we highlight recurring challenges, including validity versus synthesizability, limited prospective experimental validation, mode collapse and diversity loss, stereochemical and physical realism in three-dimensional design, computational cost, data scarcity, and the emerging convergence toward scaffold-conditioned generation, hybrid architectures, developability-aware optimization, and molecular foundation models.
items.summary_zh: 该综述以药物化学视角梳理2017—2025年生成式 AI 小分子发现的发展，比较五类生成机制与强化学习，并总结表示、数据集、基准及前瞻性实验验证不足等问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章适合作为生成式药物设计的方法地图，清楚指出有效性、可合成性、立体化学和物理真实性之间的取舍。它是综述而非新的基准或实验研究，且结论取决于截至2026年1月31日的文献覆盖。
items.abstract_zh: 小分子药物发现需要在巨大的化学空间中寻找同时具有高效力、选择性、可合成性，并在药代动力学和安全性特征方面可接受的候选物；现代生成式AI延续了始于 QSAR、pharmacophore modeling 和早期基于结构的 de novo design 的长久计算药物化学传统。本综述主要聚焦2017至2025年的进展，文献更新至2026年1月31日。从药物化学视角出发，它首先确立了该领域的共同基础：SMILES、SELFIES、图、fingerprints、三维坐标、voxels 和 latent vectors 等分子表示；常用数据集和基准；以及图神经网络编码器，包括 message-passing、directional 和 equivariant architectures。我们比较五种主要生成机制——autoregressive models、variational autoencoders、generative adversarial networks、normalizing flows 和 diffusion models——以及作为主要目标导向优化框架的 reinforcement learning。跨越这些方法，我们表明当前方法提供的是互补而非可互换的取舍，并突出反复出现的挑战，包括有效性与可合成性之间的矛盾、有限的前瞻性实验验证、mode collapse 和多样性损失、三维设计中的立体化学与物理真实性、计算成本、数据稀缺，以及向 scaffold-conditioned generation、hybrid architectures、developability-aware optimization 和 molecular foundation models 汇聚的新趋势。

items.title: RECON infers regions of interest from H&E images and reconstructs whole-slide molecular profiles at single-cell resolution
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial omics technologies resolve molecular expression and spatial architecture at single-cell resolution, but profiling whole slides remains costly. In practice, only a few regions of interest (ROIs) are profiled, leaving the rest of the tissue unmeasured. S2-omics was the first framework to unify ROI selection with out-of-ROI prediction, but it operates on superpixels rather than individual cells and predicts discrete cell types rather than continuous molecular profiles. Superpixel-based representations do not explicitly preserve cell boundaries, while categorical cell-type labels cannot quantify molecular expression within cells. Here we present RECON, a two-stage framework that performs ROI inference and whole-slide molecular reconstruction at single-cell resolution, predicting both continuous molecular profiles and discrete cell-type labels. In the first stage, RECON extracts morphological and microenvironmental features from individual cells to identify a representative ROI for spatially resolved single-cell molecular profiling. In the second stage, RECON trains deep learning models on molecular measurements acquired within the selected ROI and reconstructs transcriptomic or proteomic profiles for all remaining cells on the slide. Benchmarked against pathologist annotations, RECONs ROI selection outperforms the superpixel-based S2-omics approaches (IoU: 0.75 versus 0.64). For transcriptomics, refining the modeling unit from superpixels to single cells improves per-gene Pearson correlation by 22%. For proteomics, RECON surpasses the current state-of-the-art method, ROSIE, across all 16 markers, with a median per-cell Pearson correlation of 0.91 versus 0.84. Moreover, RECON delineates tumour boundaries and regions with distinct immune-cell densities, and highlights candidate tertiary lymphoid structures. Together, these results demonstrate that RECON enables informative ROI selection and whole-slide molecular reconstruction at single-cell resolution for both spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics.
items.summary_zh: RECON从H&E图像选择代表性ROI，并以单细胞尺度重建全切片转录组或蛋白组图谱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法针对空间组学的测量成本问题，在ROI选择与切片外分子预测上均给出了定量对比。
items.abstract_zh: 空间组学技术能以单细胞分辨率解析分子表达和空间结构，但对整张切片进行分析的成本仍很高。在实践中，通常只对少数感兴趣区域（ROIs）进行分析，使其余组织未被测量。S2-omics是首个将ROI选择与ROI外预测统一的框架，但它在超像素而非单个细胞上运行，且预测离散细胞类型而非连续分子图谱。基于超像素的表示并不明确保留细胞轮廓，而类别型细胞类型标签无法量化细胞内的分子表达。我们在此提出RECON：一个两阶段框架，以单细胞分辨率进行ROI推断和全切片分子重建，同时预测连续分子图谱和离散细胞类型标签。在第一阶段，RECON从单个细胞提取形态和微环境特征，以识别用于空间分辨单细胞分子分析的代表性ROI。在第二阶段，RECON在选定ROI内获取的分子测量上训练深度学习模型，并为切片中其余全部细胞重建转录组或蛋白组图谱。相对于病理学家注释的基准比较显示，RECON的ROI选择优于基于超像素的S2-omics方法（IoU：0.75对0.64）。对于转录组，将建模单元从超像素细化为单个细胞，使逐基因Pearson相关提高22%。对于蛋白组，RECON在全部16个标记物上超过当前最先进方法ROSIE，逐细胞Pearson相关的中位数为0.91，对比0.84。此外，RECON划出了肿瘤轮廓和具有不同免疫细胞密度的区域，并凸显候选三级淋巴结构。总之，这些结果表明，RECON可为转录组和蛋白组提供信息丰富的ROI选择及单细胞分辨率全切片分子重建。

items.title: GPAgentBench-2K: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Complex Clinical Action Space
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential as clinical agents, yet existing benchmarks reduce clinical workflows to static predictions or unconstrained Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with coarse action sets. To address this, we introduce GPAgentBench-2K, the first Constrained MDP (CMDP) LLM-agent benchmark for primary-care clinical decision-making, constructed from expert-validated records of real-world GP encounters. Our environment models a full spectrum of six foundational clinical actions, imposes a topological workflow prior over the action space, and operationalizes safety-informed abstention as a first-class outcome. Evaluating 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a significant performance degradation as the action space scales. Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases. Finally, we establish a reference point using Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), and show that while explicitly modeling constraints improves performance over unconstrained RL methods, it remains far from clinically acceptable safety.
items.summary_zh: GPAgentBench-2K以专家验证的真实全科就诊记录构建受约束MDP基准，评估16个LLM在复杂临床行动空间中的安全性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提示诊断准确率不能替代临床行动安全评估，适合作为医疗agent的严格测试资源。
items.abstract_zh: Large Language Models（LLMs）作为临床agent显示出巨大潜力，但现有基准将临床工作流简化为静态预测，或简化为行动集粗糙的无约束Markov Decision Processes（MDPs）。为解决这一问题，我们提出GPAgentBench-2K：首个用于基层医疗临床决策的受约束MDP（CMDP）LLM-agent基准，基于经专家验证的真实全科医生就诊记录构建。我们的环境模拟六类基础临床行动的完整范围，对行动空间施加拓扑工作流先验，并将知情安全的拒答作为一类一等结果。对16个最先进LLM的评估显示，随着行动空间扩大，性能显著下降。关键是，我们发现临床质量–安全差距：即使诊断准确率最高的前沿模型，在超过一半高风险病例中违反安全约束。最后，我们用Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization（C-GRPO）建立参考点，显示显式建模约束虽能改善相对于无约束RL方法的性能，但距离临床可接受的安全水平仍很远。

items.title: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Reasoning Engine for Early Detection of Pediatric Growth Disorders
items.abstract_or_text: Routine childhood growth surveillance is a cornerstone of pediatric care. Growth pattern abnormalities are often early manifestations of chronic disease. Yet subtle abnormalities are frequently underrecognized, leading to diagnostic delays and avoidable morbidity. We introduce SPROUT (System for Pediatric Recognition Of Undiagnosed Trajectories), a generalized, multi-agent large language model (LLM) reasoning system designed to identify a broad spectrum of pediatric growth-related conditions from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) earlier than standard clinical practice. Using a large pediatric primary care EHR dataset, we developed and validated SPROUT as a two-stage system. First, a highly specific LLM screener flags concerning longitudinal growth patterns. Second, an Orchestrator module coordinates a multidisciplinary panel of LLM agents to generate a ranked differential diagnosis. To correct systemic reasoning errors, a Trainer module injects meta-knowledge into the panel via a dedicated "Learner" agent. Diagnostic capability was evaluated using a walk-forward, visit-by-visit simulation leading up to the diagnosis date. The SPROUT screener model achieved 98% (83/85) specificity and 28% (9/32) sensitivity on a gold-standard dataset of pediatric primary care patients when evaluated one year before the index date, and 100% specificity and 47% sensitivity when evaluated using longitudinal data up to the day of diagnosis. When applied to 300 control patients (i.e., healthy or undiagnosed), the screener flagged 15. Subsequent expert panel review confirmed high suspicion for undiagnosed pathology in 33% (5/15) of these cases. In chronological walk-forward validation on disease cases, the diagnostic engine identified conditions well before standard-of-care documentation. One year prior to clinical diagnosis, the system achieved sensitivities of 81% for type 1 diabetes mellitus, 56% for pituitary disorders, and 44% for celiac disease. The SPROUT multi-agent system demonstrates the ability to detect a significant portion of latent growth-related pediatric conditions months to years before current clinical standards while minimizing false positives. These results support its potential as a decision support tool for reducing diagnostic delays in pediatric care.
items.summary_zh: SPROUT以两阶段多agent LLM分析纵向儿科EHR，在逐次就诊模拟中识别生长异常相关疾病。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了早期识别的临床数据证据，但金标准样本规模有限，尚不能支持常规临床使用。
items.abstract_zh: 常规儿童生长监测是儿科医疗的基石。生长模式异常常是慢性疾病的早期表现，但细微异常经常未被识别，导致诊断延迟和可避免的发病。我们提出SPROUT（System for Pediatric Recognition Of Undiagnosed Trajectories）：一个通用的多agent large language model（LLM）推理系统，旨在从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）中较标准临床实践更早识别广谱儿科生长相关疾病。我们利用大型儿科基层医疗EHR数据集，开发并验证了SPROUT这一两阶段系统。第一阶段，高特异性LLM筛查器标记令人担忧的纵向生长模式。第二阶段，Orchestrator模块协调一个多学科LLM agent小组，生成排序后的鉴别诊断。为纠正系统性推理错误，Trainer模块经由专门的“Learner” agent向该小组注入元知识。我们采用截至诊断日期之前、按每次就诊递进的模拟评估诊断能力。在诊断日前一年评估时，SPROUT筛查模型在儿科基层医疗患者金标准数据集上取得98%（83/85）的特异度和28%（9/32）的敏感度；使用截至诊断当日的纵向数据评估时，特异度为100%、敏感度为47%。应用于300名对照患者（即健康或未诊断患者）时，筛查器标记了15名；后续专家小组审阅确认其中33%（5/15）病例高度疑似存在未诊断病理。对疾病病例进行按时间顺序的递进验证时，诊断引擎早于标准医疗记录识别出疾病。在临床诊断前一年，系统对1型糖尿病、垂体疾病和乳糜泻的敏感度分别为81%、56%和44%。SPROUT多agent系统显示出在减少假阳性的同时，于当前临床标准之前数月至数年识别相当一部分潜在生长相关儿科疾病的能力。这些结果支持其作为减少儿科诊断延迟的决策支持工具的潜力。

items.title: En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) is fundamental to healthcare AI applications, including clinical decision support and medical information extraction. While corpora with Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) annotations, such as MedMentions, have driven progress in English biomedical NER, no comparable resource exists for Vietnamese. This paper presents En-ViMedNER, the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, which are language-neutral codes providing a shared cross-lingual label space and ensuring direct comparability with existing UMLS-based resources. The corpus contains 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 English-Vietnamese sentence pairs, and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types adapted from the MedMentions ST21pv dataset. To balance quality and scalability, we have constructed the corpus through automatic translation, expert post-editing, LLM-assisted label projection, and human verification and adjudication. We characterize En-ViMedNER as a large-scale silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset. We evaluate En-ViMedNER in two settings: (i) Vietnamese-input/Vietnamese-output biomedical NER and (ii) English-input/Vietnamese-output cross-lingual NER. For Vietnamese NER, we benchmark Vietnamese-supervised encoder models, English-supervised multilingual encoder models, and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 52.70 on the test set and 53.78 on the mini-test set. For cross-lingual NER, we benchmark encoder-decoder models and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 45.44 on the mini-test set. We publicly release our corpus, corpus construction pipeline, and baseline models to facilitate future Vietnamese biomedical NLP research.
items.summary_zh: En-ViMedNER发布英越平行生物医学NER语料，覆盖202,949个对齐实体提及及21类UMLS语义类型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 公开的跨语言语料、构建流程和基线模型可补足越南语生物医学NLP资源缺口。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学命名实体识别（NER）是医疗AI应用的基础，包括临床决策支持和医学信息提取。带有Unified Medical Language System（UMLS）注释的语料库，如MedMentions，已推动英语生物医学NER进展，但越南语尚无可比资源。本文提出En-ViMedNER：首个使用UMLS语义类型标注的英越平行生物医学NER语料库。这些类型是语言无关的代码，提供共享的跨语言标签空间，并确保可与现有的UMLS资源直接比较。该语料库包含4,392对PubMed摘要、44,892对英越句子，以及202,949对跨21种语义类型的对齐实体提及；语义类型由MedMentions ST21pv数据集调整而来。为平衡质量与可扩展性，我们通过自动翻译、专家后编辑、LLM辅助标签投射，以及人工核验和裁决构建语料。我们将En-ViMedNER描述为大规模银标准语料，并配有经人工审计和共识修正的小型测试子集。我们在两种设置下评估En-ViMedNER：（i）越南语输入/越南语输出的生物医学NER；（ii）英语输入/越南语输出的跨语言NER。对于越南语NER，我们基准测试了以越南语监督的编码器模型、以英语监督的多语言编码器模型和提示式LLM。最佳模型在测试集上的F1为52.70，在小型测试集上的F1为53.78。对于跨语言NER，我们基准测试了编码器–解码器模型和提示式LLM。最佳模型在小型测试集上的F1为45.44。我们公开发布语料库、语料构建流程和基线模型，以促进未来越南语生物医学NLP研究。

items.title: An experiment-calibrated in-silico AI co-scientist discovers chemoselective silicon-nitride passivation for area-selective SiO2 atomic layer deposition
items.abstract_or_text: Area-selective atomic layer deposition (AS-ALD) of SiO 2 -on-SiO 2 requires passivating adjacent SiN to isolate charge-trap nitride in 3D-NAND. We hypothesize that a smallmolecule electrophilic inhibitor chemoselectively acylates SiN surface amines (–NH 2 /–NH) over SiO 2 silanols (–OH), capping SiN against oxide nucleation. We build an in-silico AI co-scientist that (i) constructs amorphous a-SiO 2 /aSiN surfaces validated against diffraction and calibrates their reactive-site density to experiment, (ii) benchmarks its own methods, (iii) agentically screens inhibitors, and (iv) validates against a published positive control. The core selectivity is kinetic: reaction thermodynamics are near-degenerate, but acylation strongly favors the SiN amine over the SiO 2 silanol (gas-phase barrier difference ∼0.9 eV, a stepwise addition; xTB and DFT concur on the direction), reproducing textbook amine≫silanol chemose-lectivity. With a first-principles cap oxidative-initiation barrier (Ea≈0.68 eV ⇒ kdeg≈2.9× 10 −2 /cycle), a mechanistic multi-cycle model then demonstrates the target rather than assuming it: a re-passivation supercycle (redose every 3 cycles) reaches S = 0.91 at 10 nm. Run as a genuine closed loop, the agent autonomously proposes and screens candidates, inventing a novel lead that beats a naive electrophilicity-only baseline by 2.5 eV of selectivity. Our pipeline independently reproduces the published aminosilane oxide-preference (BDIPADS), anchoring the method. The pipeline is built entirely on open-source software.
items.summary_zh: 该工作构建经实验校准的计算 AI co-scientist，在 SiO2-on-SiO2 area-selective ALD 中筛选可选择性酰化 SiN 表面胺基的抑制剂，并用多周期机理模型预测再钝化策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把无定形表面构建、反应位点校准、方法自检、候选筛选和已发表阳性对照复现整合到同一计算流程，并给出动力学选择性的物理解释。新 lead 与工艺效果目前主要来自计算和模型推演，需由实际 ALD 实验确认。
items.abstract_zh: SiO2-on-SiO2 的 area-selective atomic layer deposition（AS-ALD）需要钝化相邻的 SiN，以在3D-NAND中隔离 charge-trap nitride。我们假设，一种小分子亲电抑制剂可相对于 SiO2 silanols（–OH）选择性酰化 SiN 表面胺基（–NH2/–NH），从而封端 SiN 并阻止氧化物成核。我们构建了一个 in-silico AI co-scientist，该系统：(i) 构建经衍射验证的无定形 a-SiO2/aSiN 表面，并将其反应位点密度校准至实验；(ii) 对自身方法进行基准评估；(iii) 以智能体方式筛选抑制剂；以及 (iv) 用已发表的阳性对照验证。核心选择性是动力学性的：反应热力学近乎简并，但酰化强烈偏向 SiN amine 而非 SiO2 silanol（气相能垒差约0.9 eV，为逐步加成；xTB 和 DFT 对方向结论一致），重现了教科书式的 amine≫silanol 化学选择性。以第一性原理得到的封端氧化起始能垒（Ea≈0.68 eV ⇒ kdeg≈2.9×10−2/cycle）为基础，一个机理多周期模型展示而非假定了目标：再钝化 supercycle（每3个 cycle 再加药一次）在10 nm时达到 S=0.91。作为真正的 closed loop 运行时，智能体自主提出并筛选候选物，发明了一个新 lead，其选择性比朴素的仅按亲电性筛选基线高2.5 eV。我们的流程独立重现了已发表的 aminosilane oxide-preference（BDIPADS），为方法提供了依据。该流程完全建立在开源软件之上。
items.author_line: Anand Sahu

items.title: Transfer Protocol Matters More Than Source-Task Selection in Low-Data Molecular Property Prediction: An Audit of QM9 Pretraining on Computed Oxidation Potentials and Redox Reaction Energies
items.abstract_or_text: Pretraining a network on QM9 quantum-chemical labels and transferring it to a data-scarce molecular endpoint is a common strategy in chemical machine learning, and a growing literature proposes tasksimilarity descriptors for deciding which source task to transfer from. We audit both decisions on two non-synthetic computational chemistry datasets — DFT-derived oxidation potentials (OxPot, 15,238 molecules) and redox reaction energies (RedDB, 15,551 molecules) — using 24 independently initialised QM9 source models spanning eight quantum-chemical tasks. We first establish, in a controlled synthetic benchmark with known informative coordinates, that magnitude-pruning masks can be aggregated into interpretable task-level feature-usage signatures that recover ground-truth feature overlap (pooled mean Spearman 0.2749, versus 0.1755 for unpruned first-layer weights and 0.0614 for a random control). Eleven signature series were compared; their relative ordering proved sensitive to pooling, with gradient saliency ahead in the unmatched pooled summary (0.2855) and behind by 0.211 in a paired same-setting audit. This mechanism did not translate into deployable source selection: on the two molecular datasets every selector produced negative mean transfer gain under full-weight transfer (feature-similarity top-1: −0.124, negative-transfer rate 95.8%; pseudo-label top-1: −0.177, 100%), and an agreement gate limited harm mainly by abstaining in 87.5% of cases. We then evaluated 144 matched case–source pairs under four transfer protocols (576 transfer runs). At the target-case level, resetting the output head improved relative gain by 0.087 (case-bootstrap 95% CI 0.070–0.106; 18/18 cases positive), and restricting transfer to the first layer added 0.044 (95% CI 0.034–0.055; 18/18 positive). Protocol changes produced the largest and most consistent shifts in realised gain. Only under the most conservative protocol did any dataset reach non-negative mean transfer (OxPot, +0.003; RedDB remained negative). For this setting, transfer protocol and an explicit abstention option deserve priority over increasingly elaborate sourcesimilarity descriptors.
items.summary_zh: 该审计在 OxPot 与 RedDB 上比较 QM9 预训练源任务选择与四种迁移协议，发现重置输出头和仅迁移第一层比复杂的源任务相似性选择更一致地改善相对迁移收益。

items.abstract_zh: 在 QM9 量子化学标签上预训练网络，再将其迁移到数据稀缺的分子终点，是化学机器学习中的常见策略；越来越多的文献提出 task similarity descriptors，用于决定从哪个源任务迁移。我们在两个非合成的计算化学数据集——DFT-derived oxidation potentials（OxPot，15,238 molecules）和 redox reaction energies（RedDB，15,551 molecules）——上审计这两项决策，使用覆盖八项量子化学任务的24个独立初始化 QM9 源模型。我们首先在具有已知信息坐标的受控合成基准中确立，magnitude-pruning masks 可被聚合为可解释的任务级 feature-usage signatures，恢复 ground-truth feature overlap（pooled mean Spearman 0.2749，而未剪枝第一层权重为0.1755，随机对照为0.0614）。比较了十一组 signatures；其相对排序对 pooling 敏感，gradient saliency 在不匹配的 pooled summary 中领先（0.2855），但在配对的同设定审计中落后0.211。这一机制未转化为可部署的源选择：在两个分子数据集上，每个选择器在全权重迁移下均产生负的平均迁移增益（feature-similarity top-1：−0.124，negative-transfer rate 95.8%；pseudo-label top-1：−0.177，100%），而 agreement gate 主要通过在87.5%的情形中弃权来限制损害。随后，我们在四种迁移协议下评估144个匹配的 case–source pairs（576次迁移运行）。在目标 case 层面，重置输出头使相对增益提高0.087（case-bootstrap 95% CI 0.070–0.106；18/18 cases 为正），而将迁移限制在第一层额外增加0.044（95% CI 0.034–0.055；18/18 为正）。协议改变产生了实现增益中最大且最一致的变化。只有在最保守的协议下，任一数据集才达到非负平均迁移增益（OxPot，+0.003；RedDB 仍为负）。对于该设定，迁移协议和明确的弃权选项应优先于日益复杂的 source similarity descriptors。

items.title: A Visually Interpretable Histopathology-Based Immune Model Predicts T-effector Biology and Response to Immune checkpoint inhibition in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Clinical Trial and Contemporary Real-World Datasets
items.abstract_or_text: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) are central to the treatment of metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), yet only a subset of patients derive durable benefit, and clinically deployable predictive biomarkers remain an unmet need. RNA-based T-effector signatures capture cytotoxic immune biology and have been associated with ICI response in clinical trial cohorts; however, their clinical implementation is limited by the marked spatial heterogeneity of ccRCC, as well as cost, long turnaround time, sample quality requirements, and limited accessibility. Here, we developed a visually interpretable deep learning (DL) model that predicts a T-cell-enriched immune score directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained whole-slide images. To overcome the inability of H&E morphology alone to distinguish lymphocyte subsets, we trained the model using multimodal spatial supervision from CD8, PAX8, and ERG IHC, which respectively identified cytotoxic T-cell-rich regions, tumor cells, and endothelial cells, thereby constraining immune predictions to relevant tumor microenvironmental niches. The resulting H&E DL Immune score was validated by pathologist review, comparison with held-out CD8 IHC annotations, and independent datasets. The H&E DL Immune score correlated with T-effector RNA scores across independent institutional and IMmotion150 clinical trial cohorts (spearman correlations of 0.726; p=5.90x10-15 and 0.706; p=4.04x10-19). As a proof of principle, the score was used to characterize associations with key biological features across large cohorts, including sarcomatoid differentiation, BAP1 and PBRM1 mutation status, and additional transcriptomic signatures. In IMmotion150 clinical trial cohort, a median-dichotomized H&E DL Immune score, similar to RNA-based T-effector score, was significantly associated with clinical benefit from atezulumab therapy. In contemporary institutional cohorts of patients treated with frontline ipilimumab plus nivolumab or in initial 3 lines of nivolumab monotherapy, patients in the top quartile of H&E DL Immune score had significantly longer progression-free survival. Collectively, these findings support a scalable and interpretable H&E-based biomarker that captures T-effector biology and can help identify patients with ccRCC more likely to benefit from ICIs.
items.summary_zh: 研究以多模态空间监督训练可解释H&E深度学习模型，预测ccRCC的T-effector免疫评分，并在临床试验和机构队列中检验其关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把常规病理切片与免疫治疗相关生物学相连，但作为预印本，其预测性生物标志物仍需前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: Immune checkpoint inhibitors（ICI）是转移性透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）治疗的核心，但只有部分患者获得持久获益，临床可部署的预测生物标志物仍未得到满足。基于RNA的T-effector特征可捕捉细胞毒性免疫生物学，并在临床试验队列中与ICI应答相关；然而，ccRCC显著的空间异质性，以及成本高、周转时间长、样本质量要求和可及性受限，限制了其临床实施。我们在此开发了一种视觉上可解释的深度学习（DL）模型，可直接从苏木精–伊红（H&E）染色全切片图像预测富含T细胞的免疫评分。为克服仅靠H&E形态学无法区分淋巴细胞亚群的问题，我们利用CD8、PAX8和ERG IHC提供多模态空间监督训练模型；它们分别识别富含细胞毒性T细胞的区域、肿瘤细胞和内皮细胞，从而将免疫预测限定于相关的肿瘤微环境生态位。所得H&E DL Immune评分通过病理学家审阅、与留出CD8 IHC注释比较及独立数据集得到验证。H&E DL Immune评分与独立机构队列和IMmotion150临床试验队列中的T-effector RNA评分相关（Spearman相关系数分别为0.726，p = 5.90×10−15；和0.706，p = 4.04×10−19）。作为概念验证，该评分被用于描述大型队列中与关键生物学特征的关联，包括肉瘤样分化、BAP1和PBRM1突变状态以及其他转录组特征。在IMmotion150临床试验队列中，按中位数二分的H&E DL Immune评分与RNA T-effector评分相似，均与atezolizumab治疗的临床获益显著相关。在接受一线ipilimumab加nivolumab治疗，或接受nivolumab单药初始3线治疗的当代机构队列中，H&E DL Immune评分位于最高四分位数的患者具有显著更长的无进展生存期。总体而言，这些发现支持一种可扩展、可解释的H&E生物标志物；它可捕捉T-effector生物学，并可帮助识别更可能从ICI获益的ccRCC患者。

items.title: Language-Informed Flow Matching for Trend-Guided Structure-Based 3D Molecular Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) requires ligands that satisfy both 3D target affinity and 1D chemical validity. Existing controllable generation methods often rely on task-specific fine-tuning or externally imposed sampling-time guidance, adding cost and potentially conflicting with evolving 3D geometric constraints. We propose LiFT, a language-informed cross-modal framework built on Flow Matching for trend-guided 3D molecular generation across both de novo design and scaffold hopping. LiFT uses a "Sense-Evolve-Assemble" agent to generate target-aware SMILES as intermediate chemical conditions, from which a pre-trained chemical foundation model extracts continuous semantic priors. These priors are integrated into geometric generation through a lightweight semantic projector with zero-initialized adaptive normalization for stable cross-modal conditioning. We further introduce a Self-Conditioned Decoupled Router (SCDR), which modulates the velocity field according to intermediate structural states during ODE integration. Experiments on Cross-Docked2020 show that LiFT achieves competitive distribution matching while improving medicinal chemistry metrics and maintaining competitive structural validity under task-steering settings without additional generator fine-tuning. Our results suggest that language-derived chemical priors provide effective trend-level guidance for 3D molecular generation. Code and released artifacts are available at https://github.com/kasurl/LiFT.
items.summary_zh: LiFT 以 Flow Matching 实现趋势引导的3D分子生成和 scaffold hopping：智能体先产生靶点感知 SMILES，再用化学基础模型给出的语义先验调控几何生成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试在不额外微调生成器的情况下协调1D化学条件与3D结构约束，并在 Cross-Docked2020 上报告药化指标和结构有效性的改善。证据主要来自一个计算基准，尚缺合成、结合或功能实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: Structure-based drug design（SBDD）需要同时满足3D靶标亲和力和1D化学有效性的配体。现有可控生成方法常依赖任务特异微调或外部施加的采样时引导，这会增加成本，并可能与不断演化的3D几何约束冲突。我们提出 LiFT，一个基于 Flow Matching 的、语言知情的跨模态框架，用于在 de novo design 和 scaffold hopping 中进行趋势引导的3D分子生成。LiFT 使用一个“Sense-Evolve-Assemble”智能体生成靶标感知的 SMILES，作为中间化学条件；预训练化学基础模型从中提取连续的语义先验。这些先验通过带有零初始化 adaptive normalization 的轻量语义投影器整合进几何生成，以实现稳定的跨模态条件控制。我们进一步引入 Self-Conditioned Decoupled Router（SCDR），在 ODE 积分过程中根据中间结构状态调制速度场。Cross-Docked2020 上的实验表明，在无需额外生成器微调的任务引导设定下，LiFT 实现了有竞争力的分布匹配，同时改善药物化学指标并保持有竞争力的结构有效性。我们的结果表明，源自语言的化学先验可为3D分子生成提供有效的趋势级引导。代码和发布的工件见 https://github.com/kasurl/LiFT。
items.author_line: Tianyu Gao, Zhikai Su, Jiashu Li, Wenjun Gao, Zichuan Ying, Zhe Zhao, Fei Zhang, Ye Wei

items.title: Error Models for Uncertainty Quantification in Molecular Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular property optimization is essential in drug discovery and medicinal chemistry. Machine learning (ML) models have demonstrated successful predictive ability and a certain degree of generalization capabilities to predict several molecular properties, including absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) endpoints. However, quantifying the uncertainty of individual predictions remains a critical challenge. Assessing whether a given prediction is likely to be correct has the potential to fundamentally change how ML-based predictions are used in molecular design. In this work, error models (EMs), which are ML systems trained to predict the error of the primary property models, were systematically developed and analyzed to assess the reliability of property predictions. EMs were shown to discriminate between predictions of varying error levels, highlighting their utility for uncertainty quantification (UQ) and decision-making. Using both proprietary and public datasets covering diverse ADME and physicochemical endpoints, EM-derived uncertainty estimates outperformed standard UQ metrics, such as the distance to the training set or ensemble variance. Overall, random forest-based EMs built with the distance to the training set, ensemble variance, and predicted property values provided a robust and interpretable default configuration. While alternative feature sets, algorithms, and data configurations occasionally improved performance for specific ADME datasets, these gains were generally modest compared with the improvements achieved over standard UQ metrics. Feature importance and explainability of EMs were analyzed to better understand sources of uncertainty. Such explainability analyses further showed that the three EM input features provide complementary information for reliability assessment and enable compound-level interpretation of uncertainty estimates. Taken together, EMs are presented as a tool that bridges prospective uncertainty estimation and error analyses, supporting the identification of model failures and enabling more informed decision-making in molecular ML.
items.summary_zh: 该研究训练 error models（EMs）预测主分子性质模型的误差，并在私有和公开的 ADME、物理化学数据上将其不确定度估计与训练集距离、集成方差等标准指标比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 能区分可信与高误差预测有助于把分子模型用于真实决策；文中提出的随机森林默认配置兼顾解释性与表现。私有数据细节不可审阅，且不同终点偶有不同配置更优，泛化性仍须独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 分子性质优化对药物发现和药物化学至关重要。机器学习（ML）模型已展示出成功的预测能力和一定程度的泛化能力，可预测多种分子性质，包括吸收、分布、代谢和排泄（ADME）终点。然而，量化单个预测的不确定性仍是一个关键挑战。评估给定预测是否可能正确，有望从根本上改变基于 ML 的预测在分子设计中的使用方式。在本工作中，系统开发并分析了 error models（EMs），即训练来预测主性质模型误差的 ML 系统，以评估性质预测的可靠性。EMs 显示出能够区分不同误差水平的预测，凸显其在 uncertainty quantification（UQ）和决策中的实用性。使用覆盖多样 ADME 和物理化学终点的私有和公开数据集，EM 导出的不确定度估计优于标准 UQ 指标，例如到训练集的距离或集成方差。总体而言，使用到训练集的距离、集成方差和预测性质值构建的 random forest-based EMs，提供了稳健且可解释的默认配置。尽管替代特征集、算法和数据配置偶尔会改善特定 ADME 数据集的性能，但与相对于标准 UQ 指标实现的改进相比，这些收益通常较小。分析了 EMs 的特征重要性和可解释性，以更好理解不确定性的来源。这类可解释性分析还表明，三个 EM 输入特征为可靠性评估提供互补信息，并能实现化合物层面的不确定度估计解释。综上，EMs 被提出为连接前瞻性不确定度估计和误差分析的工具，可支持识别模型失效，并在分子 ML 中实现更明智的决策。
items.author_line: Raquel Parrondo-Pizarro, Jessica Lanini, Raquel Rodríguez-Pérez

items.title: Do Pathology Foundation Models Learn Biology? Uncertainty-Based Evaluation on AML Cytomorphology
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Pathology foundation models are increasingly deployed as feature extractors for medical image analysis, yet their advantage over general-purpose vision models in unsupervised settings has not been directly tested. We held the clustering pipeline fixed and varied only the backbone across three pretraining regimes on the AML-Cytomorphology LMU dataset (17,447 single-c cell types): ResNet50 (supervised, ImageNet), DINOv2-large (self-supervised, natural images), and Virchow2 (self-supervised, 3.1 million pathology whole-slide images). Per-cell uncertainty scores served as a probe of biological structure. Virchow2 uncertainty differed substantially across cell types (Kruskal-Wallis H = 178.2, p = 1.5 × 10 −30 ), with transitional myeloid precursors showing higher uncertainty than mature stable types (Ω¯ = 0.384 vs. 0.313, p = 4.3 × 10 −15 ). DINOv2 and ResNet50 showed no such pattern. DINOv2 ranked first on all internal clustering metrics (Silhouette=0.522) yet last on biological recovery (ARI=0.033); Virchow2 showed the inverse ordering. Across five seeds, Virchow2 clustering accuracy fluctuated widely (ARI=0.016 ± 0.006) while its uncertainty structure remained stable, identifying uncertainty as the more reliable signal of representation quality.
items.summary_zh: 该研究固定聚类流程，仅替换视觉骨干网络，并用细胞不确定性检验病理基础模型是否恢复AML细胞形态学的生物结构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它指出内部聚类指标与生物学恢复能力可能脱钩，为病理基础模型评估提供了更谨慎的视角。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 病理基础模型日益被部署为医学图像分析的特征提取器，但其相较通用视觉模型在无监督场景中的优势尚未被直接检验。我们固定聚类流程，仅改变三个预训练方案中的骨干网络：ResNet50（监督式，ImageNet）、DINOv2-large（自监督，自然图像）和Virchow2（自监督，310万张病理全切片图像），并在AML-Cytomorphology LMU数据集（17,447个单细胞）上比较。每个细胞的不确定性分数被用作生物结构的探针。Virchow2的不确定性在不同细胞类型间存在显著差异（Kruskal-Wallis H = 178.2，p = 1.5 × 10−30）；过渡性髓系前体的不确定性高于成熟稳定类型（Ω¯ = 0.384对0.313，p = 4.3 × 10−15）。DINOv2和ResNet50未表现出这一模式。DINOv2在所有内部聚类指标上均居首（Silhouette = 0.522），但在生物学恢复上居末（ARI = 0.033）；Virchow2的排序则相反。在五个随机种子中，Virchow2的聚类准确率波动很大（ARI = 0.016 ± 0.006），但其不确定性结构保持稳定，表明不确定性是表征质量更可靠的信号。

items.title: Half of alcohol, drug, and self-harm presentations cannot be identified in coded emergency department data: a diagnostic accuracy study of a large language model
items.abstract_or_text: Objective To measure the accuracy of clinical coding, clinician review, and a locally deployed large language model (LLM) in identifying alcohol, drug, and self-harm involvement in emergency department (ED) attendances, and quantify prevalence. Design Two-phase diagnostic accuracy study. In a validation week, the identification strategies were assessed against a conflict-adjudicated reference standard (n=2,256); the LLM was then applied to n=105,096 annual attendances at the same site. Setting UK Type 1 Emergency Department treating patients [≥]16yrs. Main outcome measures Prevalence quantification compared with the reference standard; sensitivity, specificity, and balanced accuracy of each strategy; monthly identification rates and adjusted annual prevalence. Results The reference standard identified 12.1% of attendances as involving alcohol, drugs, or self-harm (coding 6.0%; clinician 10.0%, LLM 15.6%). LLM balanced accuracy matched or outperformed clinician review in all three domains (alcohol 0.942 v 0.930, p=0.635; drug 0.959 v 0.791, p<0.001; self-harm 0.982 v 0.908, p=0.004). Coding recorded 1.07 domains per identified patient against 1.32 in the reference standard. Adjusted annual prevalence corresponded to 12,890 domain involvements per year not identifiable in coded data. Subdomain classification found at least 81.6% of self-harm attendances required medical assessment for injury or overdose before psychiatric review. Conclusions Clinical coding identified fewer than half of presentations involving alcohol, drugs, and self-harm and rarely captured co-occurring domains; under-recording was present across a full year. A locally deployed LLM generated more complete structured data from existing clinical text within NHS infrastructure, at a scale which is not feasible for manual review.
items.summary_zh: 一项两阶段诊断准确性研究比较临床编码、人工审阅和本地LLM对急诊酒精、药物和自伤就诊的识别能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在单一NHS急诊场景中，LLM从既有临床文本中补全结构化信息；其外部可推广性和实际部署影响仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 目的 测量临床编码、临床医生审阅和本地部署large language model（LLM）在识别急诊（ED）就诊中酒精、药物和自伤涉入方面的准确性，并量化其患病率。设计 两阶段诊断准确性研究。在验证周中，针对经争议裁决的参照标准（n = 2,256）评估这些识别策略；随后将LLM应用于同一地点全年n = 105,096次就诊。地点 英国Type 1 Emergency Department，收治年龄[≥]16岁的患者。主要结局指标 与参照标准比较的患病率量化；各策略的敏感度、特异度和均衡准确率；月度识别率和校正后的年度患病率。结果 参照标准识别12.1%的就诊涉及酒精、药物或自伤（编码6.0%；临床医生10.0%；LLM 15.6%）。LLM在全部三个领域的均衡准确率与临床医生审阅相当或更高（酒精0.942对0.930，p = 0.635；药物0.959对0.791，p < 0.001；自伤0.982对0.908，p = 0.004）。对于每名被识别患者，编码记录1.07个领域，而参照标准记录1.32个领域。校正后的年度患病率对应于每年12,890个无法在编码数据中识别的领域涉入。亚领域分类发现，至少81.6%的自伤就诊需要先对损伤或过量服药进行医学评估，再进行精神科审阅。结论 临床编码识别出的酒精、药物和自伤相关就诊不足一半，且很少捕捉共现领域；全年均存在少记。本地部署LLM可在NHS基础设施内，从既有临床文本生成更完整的结构化数据，且达到人工审阅无法实现的规模。
items.author_line: Humphries, C., Brett, J., Gruber, F., James, E., McKendrick, T. I., McNairn, K. C., Miell, A., O'Brien, R., Rahman, F., Schölin, L., Stewart, M., Casey, A.

items.title: Design and characterization of broadly protective influenza A(H3N2) vaccine candidates using protein language models
items.abstract_or_text: Seasonal influenza A viruses cause significant global morbidity each year. Although vaccination remains the primary preventive strategy, effectiveness is often reduced by antigenic drift. This challenge is particularly pronounced for influenza A(H3N2), which has required eight vaccine updates over the past decade. Here, we present a computational framework to engineer broadly reactive influenza A(H3N2) vaccines, using protein language models to generate novel hemagglutinin (HA) sequences and a machine learning model to predict antigenic distance from circulating strains. In a proof-of-concept study, seven HA candidates designed using sequence data from 2013-2018 were evaluated in mice against contemporary and subsequently circulating viruses. Two candidates elicited protective levels of reactive antibodies, robust H3-specific antibody-secreting cell responses, and cross-neutralization against contemporary clades and drifted 2019-2020 strains. These findings demonstrate that an integrated generation-selection strategy can enhance vaccine coverage across current and future A(H3N2) seasons and may be applicable to other influenza subtypes.
items.summary_zh: 研究利用蛋白质语言模型生成H3N2血凝素序列并预测抗原距离，在小鼠中表征7个候选疫苗。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 计算生成与动物实验结合，为广谱流感疫苗设计提供了初步证据，但尚非人体有效性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 季节性influenza A病毒每年造成显著的全球疾病负担。尽管疫苗接种仍是主要预防策略，抗原漂移常使疫苗效力降低。对于influenza A(H3N2)，这一挑战尤为突出：过去十年中已进行八次疫苗更新。我们在此提出一个计算框架，用蛋白质语言模型生成新的血凝素（HA）序列，并用机器学习模型预测与流行毒株的抗原距离，以工程化获得广泛反应性的influenza A(H3N2)疫苗。在概念验证研究中，我们使用2013–2018年的序列数据设计7个HA候选物，并在小鼠中针对当代和随后流行的病毒进行评估。两个候选物诱导了具有保护水平的反应性抗体、强健的H3特异性抗体分泌细胞应答，以及针对当代分支和漂移的2019–2020毒株的交叉中和。这些发现表明，一体化的生成–筛选策略可增强当前及未来A(H3N2)季节的疫苗覆盖，并可能适用于其他流感亚型。
items.author_line: Howard, V. R., Allen, J. D., Thomas, M. H., Sautto, G. A., Ross, T. M., Georgiev, I. S.

items.title: Autoregressive Mosaics: Probing 2D Spatial Reasoning in Text-Only Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) trained only on text and code can sometimes generate programs that draw recognizable images. However, it is unclear whether this reflects an internal representation of 2D spatial layout or simply the ability to translate spatial descriptions into code. We introduce Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench), a benchmark that separates these factors: First, a translation task gives a model a fully specified geometry of a picture in words as a prompt and asks for the code that produces it. Second, a layout task requires the model to compose an image from an underspecified prompt. Across eight open-weight text-and-code-only models, all models reliably translate specified geometry into code, but their open-ended layout performance differs substantially, indicating that these differences are not explained by code-generation ability alone. An output-medium ablation further shows that the interface or medium of expression that the model uses matters: replacing procedural code with raw SVG improves layout scores across all models. Finally, probing model activations shows that a coarse layout plan is present before generation, but reflects only the layout implied by the prompt. During generation, models track the evolving geometric state instead of executing an initially fixed plan. Overall, these results show that 2D spatial performance in text-only LLMs depends on both the model and the output medium, and is not explained by code-generation ability alone.
items.summary_zh: AM-Bench 将文字描述到绘图代码的转换，与根据不充分提示组织二维布局的任务区分开来，考察文本模型的二维空间推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 八个开源文本与代码模型在受控任务中的差异表明，空间布局表现不能仅以代码生成能力解释；输出媒介和生成过程都影响结果。
items.abstract_zh: 仅用文本和代码训练的大语言模型有时能够生成绘制可识别图像的程序。然而，尚不清楚这反映了其内部二维空间布局表征，还是仅仅反映了将空间描述翻译为代码的能力。我们提出 Autoregressive Mosaics（AM-Bench），一个将这些因素分开的基准。第一项转换任务向模型提供以文字完整指定的图片几何结构，并要求其生成产生该图像的代码；第二项布局任务则要求模型根据不充分指定的提示构成图像。在八个开源、仅文本与代码模型上，所有模型都能可靠地将指定几何结构转换为代码，但其开放式布局表现存在显著差异，说明这些差异不能仅由代码生成能力解释。对输出媒介的消融还显示，模型使用的表达界面或媒介会产生影响：用原始 SVG 替换过程式代码可提高所有模型的布局得分。最后，对模型激活的探查显示，生成前已有粗略布局计划，但它只反映提示隐含的布局；在生成过程中，模型会跟踪不断演化的几何状态，而不是执行一个起初固定的计划。总体而言，这些结果表明，纯文本 LLM 的二维空间表现同时依赖模型本身和输出媒介，不能仅由代码生成能力解释。
items.author_line: Ashwin Nedungadi, Stefan Oehmcke, Stefan Lüdtke

items.title: More Capable, Less Faithful: A Multilingual Analysis of Mathematical (Un)Solvability Detection in LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Solvability detection is one of the most challenging aspects of mathematical reasoning for Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior work has studied this capability extensively, these analyses have been limited to English. Consequently, it remains unclear whether multilingual failures arise from differences in internal Solvability Belief or from language-dependent failures to express it. To address this gap, we introduce the first multilingual benchmark of paired solvable and unsolvable mathematical problems, extending ReliableMath to French and Greek. Using this, we train multilingual probes predicting Solvability Belief and analyze the solvability detection capabilities of state-of-the-art LLMs behaviorally, representationally, and in terms of faithfulness. We find that Solvability Belief is encoded as a largely universal, language-agnostic feature, and that higher-resource languages such as English, despite achieving stronger mathematical reasoning performance, exhibit lower solvability-detection faithfulness.
items.summary_zh: 该研究把 ReliableMath 扩展至法语和希腊语，以配对的可解与不可解数学题评估模型识别题目可解性的能力及其表征忠实性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果区分了数学作答表现与可解性判断的忠实性：高资源语言中的较强数学表现，并未对应更可靠的可解性表达。
items.abstract_zh: 可解性检测是大语言模型（LLM）数学推理中最具挑战性的方面之一。尽管已有工作广泛研究了这一能力，这些分析一直局限于英语。因此，尚不清楚多语言失败是源于内部的 Solvability Belief 差异，还是源于依语言而异的表达失败。为填补这一空白，我们提出首个多语言基准，其中包含配对的可解与不可解数学问题，并将 ReliableMath 扩展至法语和希腊语。借助该基准，我们训练预测 Solvability Belief 的多语言探针，并从行为、表征和忠实性角度分析最先进 LLM 的可解性检测能力。我们发现，Solvability Belief 被编码为一种在很大程度上普适、与语言无关的特征；而英语等高资源语言虽然取得更强的数学推理表现，却呈现更低的可解性检测忠实性。
items.author_line: Maria-Eleni Zoumpoulidi, Nikolaos Xiros, Georgios Paraskevopoulos

items.title: Schwarz: Solver-Aware Agentic Program Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Agentic verification systems can often generate source-level specifications that look plausible, but plausibility is not enough: the verifier must still turn those specifications into SMT obligations that the solver can prove. When this step fails, current LLM-driven loops usually expose only a coarse verifier error, timeout, or unknown solver result. The model cannot tell whether the specification is wrong, a helper lemma is missing, the proof context contains irrelevant facts, or the obligation needs a different theory view. This paper presents Schwarz, an agentic verification harness that makes SMT-backed proof failure local, checkable, and repairable. Schwarz turns failed verification into obligation-local repair tasks: program-point snapshots expose checked facts at a boundary, local lemmas let the agent propose missing proof steps, and theory-aware solver policies guide the agent toward solver-friendly formulations for numeric, quantified, memory, and floating-point obligations. We implement Schwarz for C and Rust/Verus and evaluate it on 1,475 tasks. On 475 benchmarks from recent agentic verification tools, Schwarz solves 95.2% of the tasks. On 1,000 tasks from the SV-COMP 2026 ReachSafety track, averaging 1,427 LOC, Schwarz solves 91.5% of the tasks, compared with 60.1% for CPAchecker. Ablations and comparison with a pure-agent baseline show that solver-aware repair is effective and scalable.
items.summary_zh: Schwarz 为 C 与 Rust/Verus 的 SMT 验证提供面向求解器的局部修复机制，将失败证明义务转化为可检查的修复任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 1,475 个任务上报告的结果覆盖近期智能体验证基准与 SV-COMP ReachSafety；消融和纯智能体基线比较为求解器感知修复的贡献提供了直接检验。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体验证系统通常能够生成看似可信的源代码级规范，但可信并不足够：验证器仍必须将这些规范转化为求解器能够证明的 SMT 义务。当这一步失败时，当前由 LLM 驱动的循环通常只暴露粗粒度的验证器错误、超时或求解器的 unknown 结果。模型无法判断究竟是规范错误、缺少辅助引理、证明上下文包含无关事实，还是该义务需要不同的理论视角。本文提出 Schwarz，一个智能体验证框架，使基于 SMT 的证明失败能够在义务局部被检查和修复。Schwarz 将失败验证转化为义务局部修复任务：程序点快照呈现已检查事实，局部引理使智能体能够提出缺失的证明步骤，而理论感知的求解器策略引导智能体针对数值、量化、内存和浮点义务采用更适合求解器的表述。我们为 C 和 Rust/Verus 实现 Schwarz，并在 1,475 个任务上评估它。在来自近期智能体验证工具的 475 个基准中，Schwarz 解决了 95.2% 的任务。在 SV-COMP 2026 ReachSafety 赛道的 1,000 个任务上，任务平均为 1,427 行代码，Schwarz 解决了 91.5%，而 CPAchecker 为 60.1%。消融实验和与纯智能体基线的比较表明，求解器感知修复是有效且可扩展的。
items.author_line: Jingyu Ke, Ling-I Wu, Guoqiang Li

items.title: Beyond Surface Forms: Symbolic Edits as a Test for Logical Reasoning with LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) is a critical capability, as it reflects a system's ability to correctly deduce hypotheses from a given context using faithful deductive processes. However, LLM reasoning has often been shown to be sensitive to small surface-level variations in problem formulation, raising questions about whether models truly follow the underlying logical structure. Studying this behavior is challenging because the symbolic components of logical problems, such as operators and predicates, are difficult to systematically manipulate in natural language. We introduce a tool-driven framework for generating controlled, label-preserving edits to logical reasoning problems. Our method operates on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problem tasks, enabling targeted modifications to logical operators and other structural components before translating them back into natural language. Using this framework, we evaluate various LLMs under cumulative and individual operator edits and analyze their behavior in response to these changes. Our quantitative and qualitative analyses show that LLM reasoning behavior under controlled operator edits is inconsistent, regardless of model size or family: models sometimes adapt correctly to structural changes but often fail to track their logical consequences. The results from this automated stress test enable an evaluation of language models across different dimensions and help measure the reliability of their reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 该工作从一阶逻辑与约束满足问题的符号表示出发，生成保持标签不变的受控编辑，以压力测试 LLM 是否追踪逻辑算子的真实后果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 定量和定性分析均显示，不同规模、不同家族的模型面对算子编辑时表现不一致；这比只考察原始题目正确率更直接地检验逻辑稳健性。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的逻辑推理是一项关键能力，因为它反映系统能否利用忠实的演绎过程，从给定上下文中正确推出假设。然而，LLM 推理经常被证明对问题表述的微小表面变化敏感，这引发了模型是否真正遵循底层逻辑结构的疑问。研究这一行为具有挑战性，因为逻辑问题中的符号成分，如算子和谓词，难以在自然语言中被系统操控。我们提出一个工具驱动框架，用于对逻辑推理问题生成受控且保持标签不变的编辑。该方法在一阶逻辑和约束满足问题任务的符号表示上运行，能够在将它们翻译回自然语言前，对逻辑算子及其他结构成分进行有针对性的修改。借助这一框架，我们在累积和单独算子编辑下评估多种 LLM，并分析它们对这些变化的行为反应。我们的定量和定性分析表明，无论模型规模或家族如何，LLM 在受控算子编辑下的推理行为都不一致：模型有时能正确适应结构变化，却常常无法追踪其逻辑后果。这一自动化压力测试的结果可从不同维度评估语言模型，并有助于衡量其推理可靠性。
items.author_line: Ramya Keerthy Thatikonda, Wray Buntine, Ehsan Shareghi

items.title: Wrong Prediction, Right Answer: Recovering Evidence from Collapsed LLM Sequence Scores
items.abstract_or_text: When a large language model fails a reasoning task, it is often assumed to lack the underlying capability. However, this conflates a genuine absence of reasoning with a late-stage output bottleneck. We observe a consistent readout gap across diverse reasoning benchmarks: hidden-state probes successfully decode correct answers even when native sequence scoring completely collapses due to structural biases. To test whether instance-specific logic survives this collapse, we introduce a diagnostic protocol using a minimal, target-label-free additive correction. Fitting just two parameters on as few as 25 unlabeled examples recovers 9--34 accuracy points for Qwen3.5 models, transferring successfully to OLMo-2-1B and Llama-3.1-8B. Crucially, these recovered decisions persist on hard instances unresolved by simple lexical overlap and significantly exceed count-preserving permutation baselines. Our results show that many apparent zero-shot reasoning deficits are expression failures masking intact internal logic, urging a narrower interpretation of benchmark evaluations.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用隐藏状态探针和少量无标签样本上的两参数加性校正，检验推理任务中的错误输出是否仍保留可恢复的实例级证据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 Qwen3.5、OLMo-2-1B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上报告的 9–34 个准确率点恢复及置换基线比较，提示部分零样本失败可能来自输出读出环节，而非直接等同于推理缺失。
items.abstract_zh: 当大语言模型在推理任务中失败时，人们常假定它缺少底层能力。然而，这将真正缺失推理与后期输出瓶颈混为一谈。我们在多种推理基准中观察到一种持续存在的读出差距：即使原生序列评分因结构性偏差而完全失效，隐藏状态探针仍能解码出正确答案。为检验实例特异的逻辑是否在这一失效中存续，我们提出一种诊断协议，使用不含目标标签的极简两参数加性校正。在仅 25 个无标签示例上拟合这两个参数，即可为 Qwen3.5 模型恢复 9–34 个准确率点，并可成功迁移至 OLMo-2-1B 和 Llama-3.1-8B。关键的是，这些恢复出的决策在简单词汇重叠无法解决的困难实例上依然成立，并显著超过保持计数的置换基线。我们的结果表明，许多表面上的零样本推理缺陷可能是表达失败掩盖了完好的内部逻辑，因此应以更严格的方式解释基准评测。
items.author_line: Qiyao Yan, Chenpeng Wang, Liangming Pan

items.title: CARVE: Verified Expansion for Variable-Length Generation in Diffusion Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Masked diffusion language models predict tokens from a partially observed response canvas, enabling bidirectional conditioning and parallel token refinement. Yet standard masked-diffusion decoders use a rigid inference interface: the number of masked positions allocated to the answer is fixed before generation begins. Choosing this length is difficult. A short canvas can truncate reasoning or code, while a long canvas wastes computation and can perturb denoising. We introduce CARVE (Counterfactual-Aware Reveal with Verified Expansion), a training-free variable-length algorithm for masked diffusion LMs. Starting from a shorter canvas, CARVE can grow the response during decoding by inserting additional [MASK] positions. Rather than keeping every insertion, CARVE tests a candidate expanded canvas and asks a counterfactual question: would the model make similar predictions for the unresolved positions in the original canvas if the extra masked space were present? The inserted masks are kept only when they induce low Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence on aligned unresolved positions. This makes length growth a verified stability decision rather than a pure confidence heuristic. CARVE applies without retraining to both full-canvas and blockwise diffusion decoders. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CARVE consistently improves average performance over fixed-length baselines across all evaluated model families. Crucially, CARVE achieves these accuracy gains while reducing inference cost, reaching half the FLOPs of fixed-length decoding in some settings.
items.summary_zh: CARVE 为掩码扩散语言模型提供无需再训练的可变长度生成方法，仅在扩展后未解决位置的预测保持稳定时保留新增 [MASK]。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法在代码生成和数学推理基准、各受评模型家族中相对固定长度基线提高平均表现，并在部分设置中将 FLOPs 降至一半。
items.abstract_zh: 掩码扩散语言模型从部分观测的响应画布中预测 token，从而支持双向条件化和并行 token 精炼。然而，标准掩码扩散解码器采用刚性的推理界面：在生成开始前便固定为答案分配的掩码位置数量。选择这一长度很困难：较短的画布可能截断推理或代码，而较长的画布会浪费计算并可能扰动去噪。我们提出 CARVE（Counterfactual-Aware Reveal with Verified Expansion），一种无需训练的掩码扩散语言模型可变长度算法。从较短画布出发，CARVE 能在解码过程中通过插入额外的 [MASK] 位置扩展响应。CARVE 不会保留每一次插入，而是测试一个候选扩展画布并提出一个反事实问题：如果存在额外的掩码空间，模型是否会对原画布中未解决的位置作出相似预测？只有当插入的掩码使对齐的未解决位置上 Jensen-Shannon（JS）散度较低时，才保留这些掩码。这使长度增长成为经过验证的稳定性决策，而非纯粹的置信度启发式。CARVE 无需重新训练即可应用于全画布和分块扩散解码器。在代码生成和数学推理基准上，CARVE 相较固定长度基线，在所有受评模型家族中均持续提高平均表现。关键是，CARVE 在取得这些准确率增益的同时降低了推理开销，在某些设置中达到固定长度解码一半的 FLOPs。
items.author_line: Wail Bouhedja, Amr Mohamed, Guokan Shang

items.title: INTERVenE: Temporal-Abstraction-Interval Based Transformers for Short-Horizon Medical Event Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Electronic Health Record (EHR) prediction models in the intensive care unit must learn from sparse and irregular measurements while preserving the clinical meaning of time and supporting transparent decision-making. We present INTERVenE, a family of Transformer architectures whose input is an interval-based, knowledge-based temporal abstraction (KBTA), a token stream of named clinical concepts (states, trends, events, contexts) drawn from a curated medical ontology, rather than an unnamed bin index or a raw measurement triplet. This naming layer is what we ask KBTA to do: it makes the model's per-token attributions resolve to clinical concepts by construction. INTERVenE offers two complementary variants: an auto-regressive decoder that generates future abstraction trajectories with a per-step risk readout (localizing when and after which events risk rises), and a bidirectional encoder for single-pass joint risk and time-to-event prediction. Evaluated on 57,078 MIMIC-IV admissions against GRU-D, STraTS, and KarmaLego, INTERVenE-Enc reaches a support-weighted AUPRC_w of 0.672, improving by 0.041 over the strongest neural baseline with non-overlapping 95\% bootstrap CIs, while also taking the best AUROC_w (0.901) and length-of-stay MAE (44.4\,h). INTERVenE-Ar (AUROC_w 0.854, AUPRC_w 0.587 under the same evaluation contract - a strictly harder generative readout) provides a complementary token-level risk trajectory. An input-representation ablation confirms the lift transfers across structured discretizations, positioning KBTA-based intervals as the interpretable substrate that makes per-token attributions resolve to meaningful clinical concepts within the deployed model.
items.summary_zh: INTERVenE将知识驱动的时间抽象区间编码为具名临床概念token，在57,078例MIMIC-IV住院记录上进行短期风险与事件时间预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把预测归因连接到可读的临床概念，同时提供与强基线的量化比较。
items.abstract_zh: 重症监护病房的电子健康记录（EHR）预测模型必须从稀疏且不规则的测量中学习，同时保留时间的临床意义并支持透明决策。我们提出INTERVenE：一组Transformer架构，其输入是基于区间、基于知识的时间抽象（KBTA），即来自经过整理的医学本体的具名临床概念（状态、趋势、事件、语境）token流，而非无名称的分箱索引或原始测量三元组。这一命名层正是我们要求KBTA完成的工作：它使模型的逐token归因在构造上解析为临床概念。INTERVenE提供两种互补变体：自回归解码器生成未来抽象轨迹并给出逐步风险读数（定位风险何时、在何种事件之后上升）；双向编码器则进行单次联合风险和事件时间预测。在57,078例MIMIC-IV住院记录上相对于GRU-D、STraTS和KarmaLego评估时，INTERVenE-Enc的支持度加权AUPRC_w为0.672，较最强神经网络基线提高0.041，且95% bootstrap CI不重叠；它还取得最佳AUROC_w（0.901）和住院时长MAE（44.4 h）。INTERVenE-Ar在相同评估约定下的AUROC_w为0.854、AUPRC_w为0.587（这一生成式读出严格来说更难），提供互补的token层面风险轨迹。对输入表示的消融证实，该提升可迁移至结构化离散化方案，表明基于KBTA的区间是一种可解释底座，使逐token归因在已部署模型中解析为具有意义的临床概念。
items.author_line: Shahar Oded, Yuval Shahar

items.title: SkillForge: Compositional Skill Synthesis with Verification-in-the-Loop for Generating Formally Verified Dafny Programs
items.abstract_or_text: Generating formally verified programs from natural language remains challenging: existing approaches either produce code in a single pass without recourse when verification fails, or rely on open-ended agentic reasoning that is non-deterministic and opaque. We introduce SKILLFORGE, a framework that decomposes formal code synthesis into a library of atomic, reusable skills, each targeting a specific subtask such as specification inference, body synthesis, invariant generation, error diagnosis, or targeted repair, and defined by a prompt template, tool binding, and decidable success criterion. A verification-driven harness orchestrates these skills: it submits candidates to the Dafny verifier, diagnoses failures into structured categories, deterministically routes to the appropriate repair skill, and iterates until formal correctness is proved or a budget is exhausted. On a curated benchmark of natural language to Dafny specification pairs, SKILLFORGE substantially outperforms both state-of-the-art agentic approaches (including ReAct-style agents, MCTS-based repair, and RL-guided verification) and traditional iterative baselines, while requiring fewer tokens and lower latency. Ablation studies confirm that every skill contributes measurably, and the harness converges rapidly with the majority of programs verified on the first attempt.
items.summary_zh: SkillForge 将自然语言到 Dafny 已验证程序生成拆为可复用技能，并根据 Dafny 验证结果以确定性方式诊断与修复候选程序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其正确性由 Dafny 验证器判定，且在自然语言到 Dafny 规格对基准上与智能体方法、传统迭代基线进行比较，并报告消融实验。
items.abstract_zh: 从自然语言生成经过形式化验证的程序仍具挑战性：现有方法要么一次生成代码，在验证失败时没有补救；要么依赖开放式智能体推理，因而具有非确定性且缺乏透明度。我们提出 SKILLFORGE，一个将形式化代码合成分解为原子、可复用技能库的框架。每项技能面向一个具体子任务，如规格推断、程序体合成、不变量生成、错误诊断或定向修复，并由提示模板、工具绑定和可判定成功标准定义。一个验证驱动框架编排这些技能：它将候选项提交给 Dafny 验证器，将失败诊断为结构化类别，以确定性方式路由至适当的修复技能，并迭代直至形式正确性被证明或预算耗尽。在一个经过整理的自然语言到 Dafny 规格对基准上，SKILLFORGE 显著超过最先进的智能体方法，包括 ReAct 风格智能体、基于 MCTS 的修复和 RL 引导验证，也超过传统迭代基线，同时使用更少 token 并具有更低延迟。消融研究确认每项技能都作出可测量贡献，且该框架快速收敛，大多数程序在首次尝试时即获验证。

items.title: Scalable Clinical Data Infrastructure and Comparative ML Evaluation for Hospitalisation Risk Prediction in Elderly Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions using CPRD
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning architectures are increasingly proposed for patient trajectory modeling in electronic health records (EHRs), yet their advantage over simpler, more interpretable models is rarely subjected to rigorous empirical scrutiny in real-world clinical settings. We present a comprehensive patient timeline pipeline applied to elderly patients in CPRD Aurum, incorporating 260 clinical conditions classified via a three-tier automated framework including specialised detection logic for 17 complex conditions. Using this infrastructure, we benchmark Temporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (TG-CNN) against Logistic Regression with LASSO regularisation and Random Forests for predicting 12-month all-cause emergency hospitalisation risk, motivated by (but not filtered to) the elevated risk of adverse drug reactions. Under cross-validation, TG-CNN achieves a marginally higher mean AUC-ROC than LASSO (0.712 vs. 0.705), whereas on the held-out test set LASSO achieves the highest discrimination of three models (AUC-ROC 0.733, versus 0.710 for Random Forest and 0.702 for TG-CNN). We show, that discrimination alone is an incomplete criterion for clinical deployment: after Platt calibration, LASSO is the only model with an acceptable calibration slope (0.817), while Random Forest (0.759) and, TG-CNN (0.391) remain substantially miscalibrated. We argue that LASSO, not the highest-discriminating model, is the model best suited to direct clinical deployment. We present lessons for the machine learning and healthcare community regarding data infrastructure, model selection, and value of calibration and interpretability in high-stakes decision support.

items.title: SHADOWBENCH: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization
items.abstract_or_text: Autoformalization translates informal mathematical theorems into code for proof assistants such as Lean. A central challenge is that current evaluation metrics can accept type-correct but misaligned statements or reject correct statements written in a different formulation. Inspired by Pass@k, we propose SA-Pass (*Semantic Alignment Pass*), which tests formal statements using auxiliary statements called *shadows* that characterize the intended statement. A generated statement receives full credit only when it compiles, implies each shadow (forward check), and is implied by their conjunction (backward check). We instantiate SA-Pass in ShadowBench, a Lean 4 full autoformalization benchmark of 178 postgraduate- to research-level problems spanning eight mathematical areas. Claude Code (Opus 4.8) with Numina-Lean-Agent reaches 61.8\% compile rate and 11.2\% SA-Pass. Across outputs generated by six agentic configurations, SA-Pass achieves 98.8\% binary agreement with expert judgments. An early version of ShadowBench served as the benchmark for Track 4 of the ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge.

items.title: When Do Models Win? A Learning Curve Benchmark for Molecular Property Prediction in Low-Data Regimes
items.abstract_or_text: In molecular property prediction, labeled data are often limited to tens to thousands of samples, yet it remains unclear which model classes are most effective in these low-data regimes and how their ranking evolves with data size. We present a learning-curve benchmark spanning traditional machine learning, graph neural networks, transformer-based molecular language models, rotationally equivariant and SE(3)-invariant 3D networks, descriptor-based hybrids, multi-task learning variants, and graph–sequence fusion baselines. Training size is varied from 50 to 3,000 samples, with dataset-dependent maxima, on QM9, ESOL, Lipophilicity, and BACE under scaffold splits with repeated trials. Four patterns emerge. (1) Model optimality is regime-dependent: deep learning leads continuous physicochemical properties (ESOL, Lipophilicity) while Gaussian Process Regression leads bioactivity (BACE) across most of the range, with clear traditional-versus-deep-learning crossovers. (2) The benefit of 3D inductive bias is target-dependent: on QM9 an equivariant 3D network trained on DFT geometries is strong on LUMO and the HOMO–LUMO gap but weak on HOMO, although all three targets use the same DFT-optimized geometries; single-conformer ETKDG inputs instead give near-flat curves on Lipophilicity and BACE. (3) Pretraining chiefly raises the low-data floor rather than the mean. Its advantage concentrates where no single model dominates, typically at intermediate sizes, and its clearest effect is on worst-case accuracy: in a matched Uni-Mol pair, pretraining lifts the minimum QM9 R² at N≤200 by approximately 0.6 on every target. Neither parameter count nor pretraining-corpus size predicts the ranking — the compact ChemBERTa-2 (3.4M parameters) outperforms the far larger MoLFormer (44.5M) and SELFormer (86.8M) on ESOL, yet the ordering reverses on the other datasets. (4) Under data scarcity, model selection beats averaging: even oracle ensembles barely improve on the best single model at the smallest sizes (at most +1.2% in RMSE at N=50, and negative on ESOL). Together these results give data-scale-aware guidelines for model selection and establish learning-curve analysis as a principled tool for characterizing model behavior across the property–scale plane. Scientific Contribution: This study establishes a comprehensive learning-curve benchmark for molecular property prediction in low-data regimes, comparing a broad suite of model families across four datasets spanning physicochemical, quantum-mechanical, and bioactivity properties. It shows that the best-performing model family is jointly determined by data scale and target type — including reproducible crossovers between traditional machine learning and deep learning — and converts these findings into actionable, data-scale-aware model-selection guidelines.

items.abstract_zh: 在分子性质预测中，带标签的数据通常仅有数十到数千个样本；然而，哪些模型类别在这些低数据情形下最有效，以及其排名如何随数据规模变化，仍不清楚。我们提出一个学习曲线基准，涵盖传统机器学习、图神经网络、基于Transformer的分子语言模型、旋转等变和SE(3)不变的3D网络、基于描述符的混合模型、多任务学习变体以及图—序列融合基线。在 QM9、ESOL、Lipophilicity 和 BACE 上，采用 scaffold split 和重复试验，将训练规模从50变化至3,000个样本，最大值随数据集而异。出现了四种模式。(1) 模型最优性取决于所处区间：深度学习在连续物理化学性质（ESOL、Lipophilicity）上领先，而 Gaussian Process Regression 在大部分范围内的生物活性（BACE）上领先，传统学习与深度学习之间存在明确的交叉。(2) 3D归纳偏置的益处取决于目标：在 QM9 上，使用 DFT 几何结构训练的等变3D网络在 LUMO 和 HOMO–LUMO gap 上表现强劲，但在 HOMO 上较弱，尽管三个目标使用相同的 DFT 优化几何结构；单构象 ETKDG 输入在 Lipophilicity 和 BACE 上反而呈现近乎平坦的曲线。(3) 预训练主要提高低数据下限，而非平均值。其优势集中于没有单一模型占优的情形，通常是中等规模；最明显的效果在最差情形准确度上：在配对的 Uni-Mol 中，预训练在每个 QM9 目标上将 N≤200 时的最小 R²提高约0.6。参数量和预训练语料规模均不能预测排名——紧凑的 ChemBERTa-2（3.4M parameters）在 ESOL 上优于大得多的 MoLFormer（44.5M）和 SELFormer（86.8M），但该排序在其他数据集上逆转。(4) 数据稀缺时，模型选择胜过平均：即使 oracle ensemble 在最小样本量时也几乎不改善最佳单模型（N=50时 RMSE 至多+1.2%，且在 ESOL 上为负）。这些结果共同给出随数据规模变化的模型选择指南，并将学习曲线分析确立为在性质—规模平面上刻画模型行为的原则性工具。科学贡献：本研究建立了一个全面的低数据分子性质预测学习曲线基准，在覆盖物理化学、量子力学和生物活性性质的四个数据集上比较广泛的模型家族。它表明，最佳模型家族由数据规模和目标类型共同决定，包括传统机器学习与深度学习之间可复现的交叉，并将这些发现转化为可操作的、随数据规模变化的模型选择指南。

items.title: Molecular basis of AMPA receptor labeling by ligand-directed acyl imidazole chemistry in living neurons
items.abstract_or_text: Rational design of covalent protein-labeling reagents in complex biological environments requires a molecular-level understanding of how the protein microenvironment governs chemical reactivity; yet, such mechanistic details remain inaccessible to experimental methods alone. In living neurons, Ligand-Directed Acyl Imidazole (LDAI) chemistry has been used to label AMPA receptors as a traceless, affinity-based protein labeling method. Although LDAI labeling reagents have been optimized in the lab, the atomic details of their interactions with the protein and the underlying mechanism remain elusive. In this work, we combined Quantum Mechanical (QM) calculations and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to propose a detailed reaction mechanism for AMPAR labeling by LDAI reagents and to clarify how the protein microenvironment governs reactivity. Although Lys residues are usually protonated at physiological pH and therefore less nucleophilic in water, our QM results show that Lys labeling is energetically more favorable than competing reactions with Ser or water. MD simulations reveal that PFQX ---the LDAI reagent precursor--- binds dynamically to the GluA2 AMPAR as an antagonist, inducing conformational changes that reshape the local environment of the acyl imidazole (AI) warhead, underscoring that ligand identity strongly affects labeling outcomes. We also identified intra and intermolecular hydrogen bond networks that may contribute to further immobilize and pre-organize the LDAI reagent. Moreover, the probe's chemical nature shapes its interactions with the Ligand Binding Domain (LBD), offering a plausible rationale for the previously experimentally observed ligand-dependent fluorescent response. Taken together, our results establish design principles for exploiting the reagent geometry and binding pocket hydrogen-bonding networks for the rational design of LDAI reagents.
items.summary_zh: 研究结合 QM 计算与 MD 模拟，解析 Ligand-Directed Acyl Imidazole（LDAI）试剂在活神经元中标记 GluA2 AMPAR 的反应机制，并提出由配体构型与氢键网络指导试剂设计的原则。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把共价标记的化学选择性放到真实受体微环境中解释，对化学探针设计有参考价值；其机制结论以计算为主，仍需针对关键中间态和位点选择性进行实验检验。
items.abstract_zh: 在复杂生物环境中理性设计共价蛋白标记试剂，需要从分子层面理解蛋白质微环境如何控制化学反应性；然而，仅靠实验方法无法获得这类机制细节。在活神经元中，Ligand-Directed Acyl Imidazole（LDAI）化学已被用于标记 AMPA receptors，作为一种无痕、基于亲和力的蛋白标记方法。尽管实验室已优化 LDAI 标记试剂，其与蛋白质相互作用的原子细节和潜在机制仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们结合 Quantum Mechanical（QM）计算和 molecular dynamics（MD）模拟，提出 LDAI 试剂标记 AMPAR 的详细反应机制，并阐明蛋白质微环境如何控制反应性。虽然 Lys 残基在生理pH下通常被质子化，因此在水中的亲核性较低，我们的 QM 结果表明，Lys 标记在能量上比与 Ser 或水的竞争反应更有利。MD 模拟显示，PFQX——LDAI 试剂前体——以拮抗剂形式动态结合 GluA2 AMPAR，诱导构象变化并重塑 acyl imidazole（AI）warhead 的局部环境，强调配体身份强烈影响标记结果。我们还识别出分子内和分子间氢键网络，它们可能有助于进一步固定和预组织 LDAI 试剂。此外，探针的化学性质塑造其与 Ligand Binding Domain（LBD）的相互作用，为此前实验观察到的配体依赖性荧光响应提供了合理解释。综上，我们的结果确立了利用试剂几何构型和结合口袋氢键网络进行 LDAI 试剂理性设计的原则。
items.author_line: Guzman-Ocampo, D. C., De Sancho, D., Lopez, X.

items.title: ALIGNing Learned Representations: Domain-General Models Triangulate Physicochemical Interactions in Analytical Separations
items.abstract_or_text: Despite rapid progress, foundation models for chemistry have yet to consistently deliver broadly transferable, experiment-grounded representations for structure-to-measurement tasks in practice. This reflects both the scarcity and fragmentation of experimental datasets and the weak alignment between common molecular representations (e.g., SMILES and graphs) and measured chemical behaviour. Here, we formalize domain-general models: pretrained models constrained across multiple measurement contexts within a physically coherent domain to learn transferable chemical representations that capture how molecular structure gives rise to experimental observables. Using liquid chromatography as a testbed, we develop ALIGN and show that it outperforms conventional baselines, including foundation models and transfer learning approaches, across diverse chromatographic contexts while retaining performance in data-limited and chemically out-of-distribution settings. By training across multiple chromatographic methods, ALIGN triangulates an underlying physicochemical interaction space, with each method providing a complementary projection that constrains the learned representation. We show that ALIGN learns embeddings consistent with physicochemical properties and chromatographic principles and provide evidence for a mechanism underlying improved method-specific adaptation. These representations transfer to related analytical modalities, including GC, CCS, and DMS, suggesting that these measurements encode overlapping physicochemical relationships. Together, these results demonstrate the value of physically grounded representation learning and suggest that domain-general approaches may extend to other fragmented scientific domains.
items.summary_zh: ALIGN 在液相色谱的多种实验条件间学习受物理化学约束的通用表示，并将其迁移到 GC、CCS 和 DMS 等分析测量任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将跨实验条件训练与可解释的物理化学相互作用联系起来，对碎片化实验数据下的表示学习具有方法价值，并报告了低数据和分布外情形的表现。其跨模态迁移仍需在更多仪器、实验室和化学空间中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管进展迅速，化学基础模型在实践中尚未稳定提供可广泛迁移、以实验为依据的结构到测量任务表示。这既反映了实验数据集的稀缺与碎片化，也反映了常用分子表示（例如 SMILES 和图）与实测化学行为之间的对齐较弱。这里，我们形式化定义了 domain-general models：在物理上连贯的领域内、跨多个测量情境受约束的预训练模型，以学习能够捕捉分子结构如何产生实验观测值的可迁移化学表示。以 liquid chromatography 为测试平台，我们开发 ALIGN，并显示其在多样色谱情境中优于常规基线，包括基础模型和迁移学习方法，同时在数据有限和化学分布外情形中保持性能。通过跨多种色谱方法训练，ALIGN 对一个潜在的物理化学相互作用空间进行三角定位，每种方法提供一个互补投影，从而约束所学习的表示。我们表明，ALIGN 学得的嵌入与物理化学性质和色谱原理一致，并提供了改进方法特异性适配的机制证据。这些表示可迁移至相关分析模态，包括 GC、CCS 和 DMS，提示这些测量编码了重叠的物理化学关系。总体而言，这些结果展示了以物理为依据的表示学习的价值，并表明 domain-general 方法可能扩展至其他碎片化科学领域。
items.author_line: Cailum M. K. Stienstra, Yen-Nhi Hoang, Chen Zhao, Alisa Hui, Emir Nazdrajić, Pelle Simpson, Aurelie Roux, August Allen, Michael Widrich, Daniel Domingo-Fernández, W. Scott Hopkins

items.title: VisXAI: Structure-Mapped Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Molecular Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Background. Molecular machine-learning models use representations such as fingerprints, tokenized simplified molecular input line entry system (SMILES) strings, and molecular graphs. Explanation methods then return importance values for fingerprint bits, sequence tokens, graph nodes, or graph edges. These values must then be mapped to atoms and bonds. This mapping depends on the representation and is often implemented separately for each model. Results. We present VisXAI, a modular Python framework for molecular featurization, trainedmodel interfaces, attribution, structural mapping, and visualization. It supports TreeSHAP for Morgan and MACCS fingerprints. For tokenized SMILES models, it supports attention, Integrated Gradients, and Grad-CAM. For PyTorch Geometric graph neural networks, it supports Integrated Gradients and Grad-CAM. Pretrained Hugging Face sequence checkpoints are supported through a tokenizer adapter and model loader. Every pathway produces the same explanation object containing atom and optional bond scores in RDKit index space. Explanations can be rendered as static two-dimensional scalable vector graphics (SVG), compared in a notebook dashboard with shared or per-panel color scales, or explored using a linked molecule/SMILES widget inspired by XSMILES. Six executable notebooks cover the three representation families, pretrained sequence models, interactive comparison, and a logP case study with an exact Crippen reference decomposition. The current source tree defines 619 Python test cases and 44 JavaScript tests, with separate continuous-integration jobs for the Python and widget front ends. Conclusions. VisXAI does not introduce a predictive architecture or attribution algorithm. It provides a tested integration and mapping layer for expressing different types of molecular explanations in the same chemical coordinates. The framework supports model analysis, method comparison, and reproducible molecular-XAI workflows without requiring separate mapping and visualization code for each representation.
items.summary_zh: VisXAI 提供统一的分子特征化、归因、原子/键结构映射和可视化框架，将 fingerprint、tokenized SMILES 与图模型的解释映射到同一 RDKit 化学坐标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具把分子 XAI 中常被分散实现的结构映射与比较过程标准化，并提供可执行 notebook 和大量测试，有助于提高解释性分析的可复现性。它不提出新的预测架构或归因算法，科学发现能力取决于上游模型与解释方法本身。
items.abstract_zh: 背景。分子机器学习模型使用 fingerprint、tokenized simplified molecular input line entry system（SMILES）字符串和分子图等表示。解释方法随后返回 fingerprint bits、sequence tokens、graph nodes 或 graph edges 的重要性数值。这些数值必须被映射到原子和键。该映射取决于表示，并且常为每个模型单独实现。结果。我们提出 VisXAI，一个用于分子特征化、trained model interfaces、attribution、structural mapping 和 visualization 的模块化 Python 框架。它支持用于 Morgan 和 MACCS fingerprints 的 TreeSHAP。对于 tokenized SMILES 模型，它支持 attention、Integrated Gradients 和 Grad-CAM。对于 PyTorch Geometric 图神经网络，它支持 Integrated Gradients 和 Grad-CAM。通过 tokenizer adapter 和 model loader 支持预训练 Hugging Face sequence checkpoints。每条流程均产生相同的解释对象，其中包含 RDKit index space 中的原子分数及可选的键分数。解释可渲染为静态二维 scalable vector graphics（SVG），可在带有共享或按面板区分色标的 notebook dashboard 中比较，或通过受 XSMILES 启发的关联 molecule/SMILES widget 进行探索。六个可执行 notebooks 覆盖三类表示、预训练 sequence models、交互式比较，以及具有精确 Crippen reference decomposition 的 logP case study。当前 source tree 定义了619个 Python test cases 和44个 JavaScript tests，并为 Python 和 widget front ends 设置独立的 continuous-integration jobs。结论。VisXAI 不引入预测架构或 attribution algorithm。它提供经过测试的集成与映射层，用于在相同化学坐标中表达不同类型的分子解释。该框架支持模型分析、方法比较和可复现的 molecular-XAI workflows，而无需为每种表示分别编写 mapping 和 visualization code。
items.author_line: Jiaming Yao, Samanyu Kulkarni

items.title: GNMCADS: Sampling For Protein Conformation Diversity With Gaussian Network Model Guided Condition Annealed Diffusion Sampler
items.abstract_or_text: Proteins are dynamic molecules existing in diverse conformational states underlying their biological functions. Although recent approaches have enabled diverse conformational sampling by emulating molecular dynamics simulations, perturbing evolutionary information, or steering internal mechanisms of structure prediction models, predicting conformations resulting from major domain motions or motions that occur over long timescales still remains a challenge. To this end, we introduce GNMCADS, a conformational sampling strategy that enhances the diversity of protein diffusion models by selectively annealing the conditioning signal guided by the intrinsic dynamical organization of the sampled protein. Further, we implement GNMCADS in the diffusion module of AlphaFold3, enabling the generation of diverse protein conformations. When benchmarked across 92 proteins that include 54 class A GPCRs, 15 transporters, and 23 proteins with major domain movements, GNMCADS exhibits improved sampling diversity compared to other current conformational sampling methods.
items.summary_zh: GNMCADS 依据蛋白内禀动力学组织选择性退火条件信号，并在 AlphaFold3 的扩散模块中实现，以扩大蛋白构象采样的多样性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对 GPCR、转运体和大结构域运动蛋白的构象异质性问题，在92个蛋白上与现有方法比较。评价指标为采样多样性，仍需进一步衡量构象的物理真实性、能量排序和实验可检验性。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质是以多样构象状态存在的动态分子，这些状态是其生物学功能的基础。尽管近期方法通过模拟 molecular dynamics、扰动进化信息或引导结构预测模型的内部机制，已能够实现多样构象采样，但预测由大规模结构域运动或长时间尺度运动产生的构象仍然具有挑战。为此，我们引入 GNMCADS，一种构象采样策略：它由所采样蛋白的内禀动力学组织引导，对条件信号进行选择性退火，从而增强蛋白扩散模型的多样性。此外，我们在 AlphaFold3 的扩散模块中实现 GNMCADS，使其能够生成多样的蛋白构象。在包含54个 class A GPCRs、15个 transporters 和23个具有大结构域运动蛋白的92个蛋白基准上，GNMCADS 相比其他当前构象采样方法展现出更高的采样多样性。
items.author_line: Uzum, A. S., Haliloglu, T.

items.title: Accurate detection of metagenomic strain-level associations using average nucleotide identity with StrainSpy
items.abstract_or_text: Genetic variation among microbial strains of the same species can profoundly influence their phenotypes, ecological functions, and impacts on human health. Traditionally, the relative abundance of a species has been used to identify associations between the microbiome and disease. However, this approach overlooks intra-species genetic variation and is susceptible to spurious correlations arising from the compositional nature of abundance data and microbial load. Fast, k-mer-based algorithms can now accurately estimate strain-level Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI) in metagenomes. Despite its value as an orthogonal metric for strain-level analysis, methods for conducting ANI-based association studies remain limited. To address this, we developed StrainSpy, a statistical algorithm that identifies associations between containment ANI and variables of interest across a wide range of study designs, including longitudinal and multi-cohort designs. Re-analysis of a study examining gut microbiota recovery in 12 healthy adults following antibiotic exposure revealed novel strain-level associations, including a reduction in strain-level diversity despite species persistence. Applying StrainSpy to a multi-cohort analysis of 3,414 colorectal cancer metagenomes identified novel strain-level associations with colorectal cancer. However, in a separate collection of microbiome-immunotherapy studies, no individual strain was consistently associated across cohorts. Importantly, across both datasets, StrainSpy informed containment ANI-based machine learning models achieved comparable accuracy to traditional abundance-based methods. StrainSpy is publicly available as an R package github.com/gtonkinhill/strainspy.
items.summary_zh: StrainSpy以宏基因组平均核苷酸一致性识别菌株层面的关联，并在抗生素暴露、结直肠癌和免疫治疗队列中再分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法和R包将菌种内遗传差异纳入关联研究，并在多队列中避免把未复现的关联夸大为发现。
items.abstract_zh: 同一物种内微生物菌株之间的遗传变异可深刻影响其表型、生态功能及其对人类健康的影响。传统上，研究以物种相对丰度识别微生物组与疾病的关联，但这一方法忽视种内遗传变异，且容易受到丰度数据组成性和微生物负荷所致伪相关的影响。快速、基于k-mer的算法现可在宏基因组中准确估计菌株层面的Average Nucleotide Identity（ANI）。尽管它是菌株层面分析的一项正交指标，开展基于ANI的关联研究的方法仍有限。为此，我们开发StrainSpy：一种统计学算法，可在包括纵向和多队列设计在内的广泛研究设计中，识别containment ANI与关注变量之间的关联。对一项抗生素暴露后12名健康成人肠道微生物组恢复研究的再分析，发现了新的菌株层面关联，包括在物种持续存在时菌株层面多样性下降。将StrainSpy应用于3,414份结直肠癌宏基因组的多队列分析，识别出与结直肠癌相关的新菌株层面关联。然而，在另一组微生物组–免疫治疗研究中，没有单一菌株能在各队列间保持一致关联。重要的是，在两类数据集上，StrainSpy信息支持的containment ANI机器学习模型均达到与传统丰度方法相当的准确性。StrainSpy以R package形式公开，地址为github.com/gtonkinhill/strainspy。
