items.title: PhageTAILor leverages machine learning for phage tail-like elements detection and classification in plant-associated bacteria
items.abstract_or_text: Phage tail-like elements (PTEs) -- tailocins, bacterial type VI secretion systems (T6SS), and extracellular contractile injection systems (eCIS) -- are contractile nanomachines that bacteria use to kill their neighbors and compete within their micro-ecosystems. PTEs help shape microbial community composition. Most PTE detection tools only detect a single PTE class. Moreover, most tailocin detection methods are largely restricted to Pseudomonas, leaving a key part of tailocin diversity uncharacterized. In this work, we present PhageTAILor (https://github.com/hjcho-bio/PhageTAILor), an integrative and fully automated pipeline that detects and classifies prophages and 3 PTE classes from bacterial genomes. PhageTAILor combines a 6-detector homology-based candidate search (geNomad, tail-gene, PHROGs-tail, SecReT6, eCIStem, and a divergence-tolerant tail-HMM detector) with a LightGBM classifier comprising 1 multiclass and 3 binary heads, trained on 6,501 bacterial genomes carrying 13,082 prophages and PTEs. A phylogeny-free feature matrix used in our model keeps predictions reproducible between model construction and user inference. PhageTAILor performs strongly at the genome level and generalizes beyond its Pseudomonas-rich training set. On a 76-strain cross-clade benchmark, PhageTAILor detected tailocins at F1 = 0.955. Furthermore, it identified 12 of 13 experimentally validated tailocins spanning five genera versus 2 of 13 for a Pseudomonas-restricted tool TattleTail. PhageTAILor also demonstrated sensitivity equivalent to viral detection tool geNomad while avoiding its higher false-positive rate. Applied to 7,925 plant- and soil-associated bacterial isolates, PhageTAILor showed that prophages in the phyllosphere and tailocins in plant-associated bacteria, whereas eCIS are enriched in soil. PhageTAILor is distributed as an open-source, modular pipeline with a command-line interface.
items.summary_zh: PhageTAILor联合六类候选搜索器和LightGBM，检测并分类植物相关细菌中的噬菌体尾样元件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 训练数据、跨支系基准和开源模块化流程共同支持其在微生物生态基因组学中的可复现使用。
items.abstract_zh: 噬菌体尾样元件（PTEs）——tailocins、细菌type VI secretion systems（T6SS）和extracellular contractile injection systems（eCIS）——是细菌用来杀死邻居并在微生态系统中竞争的收缩性纳米机器。PTEs有助于塑造微生物群落组成。大多数PTE检测工具只检测一种PTE类别；此外，大多数tailocin检测方法主要限于Pseudomonas，使tailocin多样性的关键部分未被表征。本工作提出PhageTAILor（https://github.com/hjcho-bio/PhageTAILor）：一个整合式、全自动流程，可从细菌基因组中检测和分类prophages及3类PTE。PhageTAILor将由6个检测器构成的基于同源性的候选搜索（geNomad、tail-gene、PHROGs-tail、SecReT6、eCIStem和耐受序列分化的tail-HMM检测器）与LightGBM分类器结合；后者由1个多类别头和3个二元头组成，在携带13,082个prophages和PTE的6,501个细菌基因组上训练。模型使用的无系统发育特征矩阵使模型构建与用户推断之间的预测保持可复现。PhageTAILor在基因组层面表现强劲，并能泛化至其以Pseudomonas为主的训练集之外。在76株跨支系基准上，PhageTAILor检测tailocins的F1 = 0.955。此外，它在跨五个属的13个经实验验证tailocins中识别出12个，而受限于Pseudomonas的工具TattleTail只识别出2个。PhageTAILor还显示出与病毒检测工具geNomad相当的敏感度，同时避免其较高的假阳性率。应用于7,925株植物和土壤相关细菌分离株后，PhageTAILor显示：叶际中的prophages以及植物相关细菌中的tailocins富集，而eCIS在土壤中富集。PhageTAILor作为开源、模块化的命令行流程发布。

items.title: An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an Escherichia coli chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches 65\pm1\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches 78\pm1\% versus 75\% on LASER, 88\pm3\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and 63\pm2\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. Fine-tuning also consistently outperforms direct prompting. These results show that route-supervised frontier selection can improve budgeted search without altering biochemical generation, although performance remains dependent on frontier construction and reaction ranking.
items.summary_zh: 该研究将 Qwen2.5-7B 用作规则驱动逆生物合成中的前沿分子选择策略，在保持生化反应生成器完全一致的条件下，评估提示和 LoRA 微调对有限搜索预算的贡献。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它较清楚地把搜索策略的作用与反应生成模型分开，且在 LASER、RetroPath RL Golden 和 BioNavi-NP 上报告了增益。结果仍依赖前沿构造与反应排序，尚未证明路线在湿实验底盘中的可行性。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型日益被用作多步逆合成智能体，这提出了一个问题：其搜索策略在多大程度上独立于底层反应模型而发挥作用。我们通过基于规则的逆生物合成，在生物学场景中研究这一问题：一个确定性的生化引擎为每种方法生成相同的已验证转化，搜索终止于 Escherichia coli 底盘可获得代谢物的路线，而策略仅选择下一步要扩展的前沿分子。经提示和 LoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5-7B 策略采用严格的仅选择接口。微调策略在 LASER 上以10次扩展达到65\pm1\%的求解率，而 MCTS 为59\%；在200次扩展时，LASER 上为78\pm1\%对75\%，RetroPath RL Golden 基准上为88\pm3\%对80\%，BioNavi-NP 基准上为63\pm2\%对45\%。微调也持续优于直接提示。这些结果表明，路线监督的前沿选择可在不改变生化生成的情况下改善预算受限搜索，尽管性能仍取决于前沿构造和反应排序。
items.author_line: Philippe Meyer, Guillaume Gricourt, Thomas Duigou, Joan Hérisson, Jean-Loup Faulon

items.title: S3C-LLM: Skill-Code Guided Agentic Language Models for Spectrum-to-Structure Elucidation
items.abstract_or_text: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation. Although this paradigm can leverage paired spectral data, it does not explicitly model the analytical workflow used by spectroscopists, such as diagnostic peak interpretation, fragment reasoning, formula constraints, and chemical consistency checking. In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation. Rather than directly predicting a molecule, S3C-LLM retrieves modality-specific spectroscopy skills, executes analysis code to instantiate these skills on the input spectra, and integrates the resulting peak-level evidence and formula constraints before generating SMILES. Specifically, we contribute a self-evolving spectroscopy skill library, a thinking-augmented skill-code trajectory construction pipeline, and a two-stage training strategy that teaches Qwen3-4B through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by our proposed step-level reinforcement learning (RL). Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that S3C-LLM consistently outperforms current general LLMs and spectrum-specific models across spectra, while using less than 1/10th of SpectraLLM's training corpus.
items.summary_zh: S3C-LLM 将谱学技能检索、分析代码执行、峰级证据和分子式约束组合到 spectrum-to-structure 流程，并以 SFT 加逐步 RL 训练 Qwen3-4B。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它避免把谱图直接映射为 SMILES，将光谱解析中可核查的中间证据纳入模型过程；多基准结果和较小训练语料具有吸引力。摘要未给出各谱学模态、数据集或难例上的具体绝对指标，需审阅完整实验设置。
items.abstract_zh: 光谱结构解析是分子分析的核心，但近期基于 Large Language Model（LLM）的方法大多将其表述为从谱图直接生成 SMILES。尽管这一范式可利用配对的光谱数据，它并未显式建模光谱学家使用的分析工作流，例如诊断峰解释、碎片推理、分子式约束和化学一致性检查。本文提出 S3C-LLM，一种由技能引导、以代码为依据的用于 spectrum-to-structure elucidation 的智能体 LLM。S3C-LLM 不直接预测分子，而是检索模态特异的 spectroscopy skills，执行分析代码以在输入谱图上实例化这些技能，并在生成 SMILES 前整合由此得到的峰级证据和分子式约束。具体而言，我们贡献了一个自我演化的 spectroscopy skill library、一个由思考增强的 skill-code trajectory 构建流程，以及一个两阶段训练策略：先通过 supervised fine-tuning（SFT）训练 Qwen3-4B，再进行我们提出的 step-level reinforcement learning（RL）。在多样基准上的实验表明，S3C-LLM 在不同光谱上持续优于当前通用 LLM 和光谱特异模型，同时使用的训练语料不足 SpectraLLM 的1/10。
items.author_line: Xuanle Zhao, Xinyuan Cai, Xiang Cheng, Bo Xu

items.title: CoMPASS: Collaborative Molecular Property Prediction via Adaptive Small-Large Model Synergy
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate molecular property prediction requires both statistical reliability and chemical reasoning. Graph neural networks can be calibrated directly on labeled assays but remain limited by the coverage of their training data. Large language models (LLMs) can compare molecular evidence and articulate chemical rationales, yet are unreliable as standalone quantitative predictors. The central challenge is therefore to determine when an LLM should influence a calibrated model and by how much. Here we present CoMPASS, a retrieval-calibrated framework for small-large model collaboration. CoMPASS retains a graph attention network (GAT) as the predictive anchor, retrieves locally relevant training molecules, provides attention-grounded evidence to an LLM, and converts its proposal into a bounded correction through an agreement-aware gate. Across six classification and two regression benchmarks, CoMPASS improves the GAT anchor in regions of correctable uncertainty while limiting LLM intervention in high-confidence regimes. Ablations show that the gains arise from validation-calibrated retrieval and bounded fusion rather than prompting alone. These results suggest that generative reasoning should augment calibrated prediction through evidence-grounded, controlled corrections rather than direct output replacement. Code is available at https://github.com/littlepeachs/CoMPASS.
items.summary_zh: CoMPASS 以 GAT 作为经校准的主预测器，检索局部相关训练分子并向 LLM 提供 attention-grounded evidence，再以一致性感知机制将建议转为有界校正。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该设计正面处理 LLM 定量预测不稳的问题，并在6个分类和2个回归基准上辅以消融实验。结论仍基于基准任务；检索质量、校准设定和 LLM 的可迁移性会影响实际效用。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的分子性质预测既需要统计可靠性，也需要化学推理。图神经网络可以直接在带标签的测定数据上校准，但仍受其训练数据覆盖范围限制。大语言模型（LLMs）能够比较分子证据并阐述化学理由，但作为独立的定量预测器并不可靠。因此，核心挑战是确定 LLM 何时应影响已校准模型，以及影响到何种程度。这里我们提出 CoMPASS，一个经检索校准的小模型—大模型协作框架。CoMPASS 保留图注意力网络（GAT）作为预测主干，检索局部相关的训练分子，向 LLM 提供以注意力为依据的证据，并通过一致性感知机制将其建议转换为有界校正。在六个分类和两个回归基准上，CoMPASS 在可校正的不确定性区域改善了 GAT 主干，同时在高置信度区域限制 LLM 的干预。消融实验显示，增益来自经验证校准的检索和有界融合，而非仅来自提示。这些结果表明，生成式推理应通过以证据为依据、受控的校正来补充已校准预测，而不应直接替换输出。代码见 https://github.com/littlepeachs/CoMPASS。
items.author_line: Wentao Li, Jiangjie Qiu, Yijun Li, Leyi Zhao, Xiaonan Wang

items.title: One Policy Is Enough: Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning Outperforms Tree Search for Chemistry Tool Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Chemistry questions often demand exact computation and database lookups that a language model cannot supply from its parameters, so it must reach for external tools. Tool use here is a three-part problem: select the right tool from a large pool, fill it with correctly typed arguments, and chain calls so that each consumes the outputs of the last. CheMatAgent, a previously published system, addresses this with hierarchical evolutionary MCTS: separate policy and execution models searching tool-call trees under two learned critics, one regressed partly onto GPT-assigned scores. We show that a single policy suffices. Our model interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and returns in one left-to-right generation, trained by a supervised warm-up and then outcome-level reinforcement learning against a programmatic reward read directly off the gold call chain, which leaves no learned critic and no judge in the training loop. On ChemToolBench multiple-tool comprehensive chemistry, on both backbones CheMatAgent use, we improve Tool F1 by 5.5% and Return F1 by 9.6% on Qwen-2.5-7B, and by 3.7% and 3.9% on Llama-3.1-8B, compared with their strongest search configuration, at one model invocation per question, against a search whose cost grows with the tree; we also lead answer Pass Rate on Qwen-2.5-7B.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以监督预热和基于程序化调用链奖励的结果级 RL 训练单一化学工具使用策略，在 ChemToolBench 上与 CheMatAgent 的层级 evolutionary MCTS 对比。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提示，在此基准中单策略可同时提升工具调用与返回结果 F1，并显著减少树搜索调用成本。验证集中于既有的 ChemToolBench 与两种小型骨干模型，尚不代表开放式科研工具环境中的可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: 化学问题常要求精确计算和数据库查询，而语言模型无法从其参数中提供这些信息，因此必须使用外部工具。这里的工具使用是一个三部分问题：从大型工具池中选择正确工具，为其填入类型正确的参数，以及串联调用，使每次调用消耗前一次的输出。先前发布的系统 CheMatAgent 以 hierarchical evolutionary MCTS 处理这一问题：在两个学习得到的 critics 下，用独立的 policy 和 execution models 搜索工具调用树，其中一个 critic 部分回归于 GPT-assigned scores。我们表明，单一策略已足够。我们的模型在一次从左到右的生成中交织 reasoning、tool calls 和 returns，先进行 supervised warm-up，随后针对直接从 gold call chain 读取的 programmatic reward 进行 outcome-level reinforcement learning，因此训练循环中没有 learned critic，也没有 judge。在 ChemToolBench multiple-tool comprehensive chemistry 上，在 CheMatAgent 所用的两种 backbones 中，我们相对其最强搜索配置，在 Qwen-2.5-7B 上将 Tool F1 提高5.5%、Return F1 提高9.6%，在 Llama-3.1-8B 上分别提高3.7%和3.9%；每个问题仅一次模型调用，而树搜索的成本随树增长；我们还在 Qwen-2.5-7B 上领跑 answer Pass Rate。
items.author_line: Armin Dariani, Sifan Wu, Bang Liu, Entao Yang

items.title: Context-aware LLM extraction and controlled-vocabulary normalization of GEO transcriptomic sample metadata
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Motivation Public transcriptomic repositories contain millions of samples, but reuse is limited by inconsistent depositor-provided metadata. In the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO), biologically critical fields such as tissue, disease state and treatment are frequently encoded within heterogeneous free text descriptions, undefined abbreviations/acronyms, or implicit experimental context. Results We developed a locally deployable large language model (LLM) pipeline converting GEO sample metadata into structured Tissue, Condition and Treatment labels. It performs sample-level extraction (Phase 1), study-level contextual inference of missing labels from GSE context and sibling-sample label distributions (Phase 1b), and controlled-vocabulary entity-linking, also called concept normalization, to Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) and Cellosaurus cell-line identifiers (Phase 2), with out-of-vocabulary clustering for concepts not within these vocabularies. We evaluated 804,427 human GEO samples against other automated annotations and manually curated benchmarks for Tissue, Condition and Treatment. On the manual benchmark, the extractor labelled Tissue and Condition at 99.67% and 95.0% accuracy. Entity linking reached accuracies of 0.985, 0.993 and 0.982 (F1 = 0.993, 0.996 and 0.991) on the labels for which a controlled-vocabulary answer exists, and separately assigned an identifier at all to 80.69%, 62.91% and 23.13% of extracted labels against 31.68%, 35.01% and 7.46% for deterministic exact MeSH matching. Availability All code, evaluation and results are provided as Supplementary Data. An interactive program built from the pipeline is available at https://github.com/SciSpectator/LLM-GEO-Label-Extractor. Contact Jonathan-Wren@OMRF.org
items.summary_zh: 该研究以本地可部署LLM将GEO转录组样本的自由文本元数据转为标准化的组织、状态和处理标签，并在804,427个人类样本上评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模、可复现的样本元数据规范化可显著提高公共转录组数据的可检索性和再利用价值。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 研究动机 公共转录组数据库包含数百万样本，但不一致的提交者元数据限制了其再利用。在Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）中，组织、疾病状态和处理等具有关键生物学意义的字段，常被编码在异质的自由文本描述、未定义的缩写/首字母缩略词或隐含的实验语境中。结果 我们开发了一条可在本地部署的large language model（LLM）流程，将GEO样本元数据转换为结构化的Tissue、Condition和Treatment标签。该流程执行样本层面的提取（Phase 1）、利用GSE语境和同胞样本标签分布对缺失标签进行研究层面的语境推断（Phase 1b），以及与Medical Subject Headings（MeSH）和Cellosaurus细胞系标识符进行受控词表实体链接（亦称概念规范化；Phase 2）；对于不在这些词表中的概念，则进行词表外聚类。我们在804,427个人类GEO样本上，相对于其他自动注释和人工整理基准评估了该流程的Tissue、Condition和Treatment标注。在人工基准上，提取器对Tissue和Condition的标注准确率分别为99.67%和95.0%。在存在受控词表答案的标签上，实体链接准确率分别达到0.985、0.993和0.982（F1分别为0.993、0.996和0.991）；另行考察是否为提取标签赋予了标识符时，其比例分别为80.69%、62.91%和23.13%，而确定性的精确MeSH匹配分别为31.68%、35.01%和7.46%。可用性 所有代码、评估和结果均作为Supplementary Data提供。基于该流程构建的交互式程序见https://github.com/SciSpectator/LLM-GEO-Label-Extractor。联系邮箱 Jonathan-Wren@OMRF.org
items.author_line: Szczepaniak M, Wren J

items.title: Clinical evaluation of artificial intelligence for diagnostics of antibiotic-resistant bacteria
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial resistance is a public health challenge, driving the need for rapid, cost-effective diagnostic support tools. Artificial intelligence (AI) may enable prediction of susceptibility to untested antibiotics from known susceptibility results, but prospective clinical validation is required before routine use. We evaluated an AI-based decision support method, trained on invasive isolates from the European Surveillance System (TESSy), for prediction of antibiotic susceptibility in clinical Escherichia coli urine isolates. The evaluation included 99 E. coli isolates from urine samples with diversity in age, sex, and antibiotic susceptibility. Predictions were evaluated for 14 antibiotics using patient metadata and susceptibility results for 4-8 antibiotics as input. Prediction uncertainty was handled using conformal prediction, allowing abstention when confidence was insufficient. EUCAST disk diffusion test results were used as reference and genomic sequence data was used to explore mechanisms of the AI performance. Without conformal prediction, 84% of predictions were correct when susceptibility results of six antibiotics were used to predict susceptibility to eight additional antibiotics. Across all predictions generated using susceptibility results for six antibiotics as input, the major and very major error rates were 19% and 12%, respectively. Prediction errors varied between antibiotics and were associated with certain phenotypic and genotypic resistance patterns. Conformal prediction reduced errors but increased abstentions; at confidence levels of 90%, 95%, and 97.5%, the model abstained in 9.6%, 14%, and 22% of instances. The method showed promising performance, but its clinical use remains limited and may require diagnostic data beyond susceptibility test results and demographic variables.
items.summary_zh: 研究在99株临床尿液E. coli分离株上评估AI药敏预测，并量化保形预测在降低错误与增加拒答之间的权衡。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是小规模临床评估，直接显示模型在抗菌药物决策支持中仍存在不可忽略的重大和极重大错误。
items.abstract_zh: 抗微生物药物耐药性是一项公共卫生挑战，因而需要快速且成本效益高的诊断支持工具。人工智能（AI）或可利用已知药敏结果预测未经检测抗生素的敏感性，但在常规使用前需要前瞻性临床验证。我们评估了一种AI决策支持方法：该方法在European Surveillance System（TESSy）的侵袭性分离株上训练，用于预测临床Escherichia coli尿液分离株的抗生素敏感性。评估纳入99株来自尿液样本、在年龄、性别和抗生素敏感性方面具有多样性的E. coli分离株。以患者元数据和4–8种抗生素的药敏结果为输入，对14种抗生素进行预测。使用保形预测处理预测不确定性，在置信度不足时允许拒答。以EUCAST纸片扩散试验结果为参照，并利用基因组测序数据探索AI性能的机制。在未使用保形预测时，当以6种抗生素的药敏结果预测另外8种抗生素的敏感性，84%的预测正确。在以6种抗生素药敏结果为输入生成的全部预测中，重大错误率和极重大错误率分别为19%和12%。预测错误因抗生素而异，并与特定表型和基因型耐药模式相关。保形预测降低了错误，但增加了拒答；在90%、95%和97.5%的置信度下，模型分别在9.6%、14%和22%的实例中拒答。该方法显示出有前景的性能，但其临床使用仍受限，可能需要药敏试验结果和人口学变量以外的诊断数据。
items.author_line: Hessel, M., Inda Diaz, J. S., Sjöberg, A., Salva-Serra, F., Helldal, L., Jirstrand, M., Johnning, A., Kristiansson, E., Skovbjerg, S.

items.title: DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Defeasible reasoning is a type of reasoning where inferences are drawn from plausible current evidence, but can be retracted upon the introduction of newer evidence. Although recent studies have examined language-model behaviors in defeasible reasoning, the datasets have been static and lack wide coverage of non-monotonic reasoning categories. We introduce DeReLab, a generative framework that produces multi-turn belief-updating conversations from parameterized graph structures across default and inheritance reasoning, with formally verified ground truth at every turn, enabling controlled measurement of how models respond to confirming and disconfirming evidence. This controlled generation process creates a testbed for experimental designs that isolate specific reasoning demands. Applying this capability to the study of confirmation bias, we evaluate nine open and proprietary large language models and find that nearly all exhibit a systematic tendency to accept congruent evidence while resisting incongruent updates, with several models correctly identifying a weakening update yet failing to revise their conclusion. We believe our work and findings will facilitate future research on evaluating language models in defeasible reasoning.
items.summary_zh: DeReLab 从参数化图生成多轮信念更新对话，并在每一步提供经形式化验证的标准答案，用于测量模型面对支持或反驳证据时是否更新结论。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将可撤销推理转化为可控、可复核的评测任务；九个模型的结果提示，表面上识别到反证并不等于实际修正推理结论。
items.abstract_zh: 可撤销推理是一类推理：可从当前看来合理的证据得出推断，但在引入新证据后可以撤销这些推断。尽管近期研究已经考察了语言模型在可撤销推理中的行为，现有数据集仍是静态的，且对非单调推理类别的覆盖不足。我们提出 DeReLab，这是一个生成式框架，可从参数化图结构生成涵盖默认推理和继承推理的多轮信念更新对话，并在每一轮提供经形式化验证的标准答案，从而能够受控测量模型对支持性和反驳性证据的反应。这一受控生成过程构建了一个试验环境，可用于设计隔离特定推理需求的实验。我们利用这一能力研究确认偏误，评估了九个开源和专有大语言模型，发现几乎所有模型都系统性地倾向于接受与原有结论一致的证据，同时抗拒不一致的更新；其中一些模型能够正确识别削弱性更新，却未能修改其结论。我们相信，本工作及其发现将促进未来对语言模型可撤销推理能力的评估研究。
items.author_line: Jayanta Sadhu, Sayem Shahad, Kenneth Marino

items.title: HSRM: Hidden-State Reward Models for Test-Time Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models can often generate plausible mathematical reasoning traces, but reliably identifying the correct solution among multiple candidates remains a key challenge. Existing test-time reasoning pipelines typically rely on text-based verifiers that re-read each generated solution, making verification an expensive component of inference. Prior work has shown, however, that LLMs often encode correctness-related signals in their internal representations, including awareness of when their own answers are likely to be wrong. Building on this observation, we introduce HSRM, a lightweight hidden-state reward model that verifies candidate solutions by directly reading the generator's internal representations rather than re-processing its text. HSRM extracts hidden states from a frozen generator at reasoning-step boundaries and uses a small Transformer encoder to rank candidates. It is trained from self-generated trajectories with outcome labels, requiring neither human-written process supervision nor a large pretrained verifier. Across four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, HSRM matches or outperforms a 55M-parameter text-only energy verifier in 15 of 16 generator--dataset settings while using only about 2M parameters, providing an efficient alternative to text-only verification by reusing representations already computed during generation.
items.summary_zh: HSRM 直接读取生成器隐藏状态，对数学解答候选排序，以较小验证器替代重新阅读完整文本的验证流程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 四项数学推理基准中的 16 组设置有 15 组达到或超过 55M 文本验证器，提供了关于隐藏状态是否可用于降低测试时验证开销的可检验结果。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型往往能够生成看似可信的数学推理轨迹，但如何从多个候选解中可靠识别正确解仍是一个关键挑战。现有测试时推理流程通常依赖基于文本的验证器重新阅读每个生成解，使验证成为推理中开销很大的环节。然而，已有研究表明，LLM 往往会在内部表征中编码与正确性相关的信号，包括意识到自己的答案可能出错。基于这一观察，我们提出 HSRM，这是一种轻量级隐藏状态奖励模型，它直接读取生成器的内部表征来验证候选解，而不重新处理其文本。HSRM 在推理步骤交界处提取冻结生成器的隐藏状态，并使用一个小型 Transformer 编码器对候选项排序。它从带有结果标签的自生成轨迹中训练，无需人工编写的过程监督，也无需大型预训练验证器。在四个数学推理基准上，HSRM 在 16 个生成器—数据集设置中的 15 个设置里达到或超过一个 55M 参数的纯文本能量验证器，同时仅使用约 2M 参数；它通过复用生成过程中已经计算的表征，为纯文本验证提供了一种高效替代方案。
items.author_line: Xianzhi Li, Xiaodan Zhu

items.title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.
items.summary_zh: GMTS 以近似梯度幅值排序选择 RLVR 训练 token，试图区分同一答案内高熵 token 与跨答案奖励差异造成的训练重要性差别。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在三类推理任务和多种模型规模中，文中报告前 20% GMTS token 的训练表现持续优于基于熵的选择，为 RLVR token 选择提供了可比较的实验依据。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL），尤其是具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），近期已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的核心范式，并在推理任务中展现出显著效果。近期研究表明，高熵 token 在模型训练中极为重要，因为仅使用熵最高的 20% token 训练就能取得显著性能增益。然而，高熵 token 为何有益仍缺乏充分理解。在本工作中，我们发现，尽管同一答案中的高熵 token 往往与较大的梯度幅值相关，但考虑到答案级奖励信号的变化，熵本身无法在不同答案之间持续反映 token 的重要性。基于这一观察，我们提出 Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection（GMTS）方法来量化 token 重要性；该方法利用熵—梯度联系近似梯度幅值排序，以进行 token 选择。我们发现，在三个推理领域和多种模型规模中，使用按 GMTS 排名的前 20% token 训练始终优于基于熵的 token 选择，这表明 GMTS 可对 RLVR 训练中 token 的贡献作出更细致的估计。

items.title: Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving
items.abstract_or_text: Plane geometry problem (PGP) solving has become a critical benchmark for multimodal reasoning because it requires accurate visual perception and precise multi-step symbolic deduction. Although test-time scaling (TTS) has demonstrated remarkable success in general mathematical reasoning, it fails to scale effectively under the symbolic-program paradigm for plane geometry. We identify two key obstacles: limited reasoning diversity induced by rigid symbolic programs and insufficient explicit visual grounding before symbolic deduction. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS), which converts each symbolic program into heterogeneous reasoning traces, including executable Python scripts and CoT-augmented variants. We further propose Perception-Augmented (PA) training, which parses diagrams into structured semantic clauses before deduction, and Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE) for efficient self-adaptive inference. Experiments on three geometry benchmarks show that our method consistently improves PGP-solving across model scales and achieves strong performance against both general-purpose MLLMs and specialized geometry solvers. Under test-time scaling, CG-MTE achieves comparable accuracy to high-budget self-consistency while reducing sampling cost by up to 8x. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Jason8Kang/ReTTS-PGPS.
items.summary_zh: 该工作通过多轨迹综合、感知增强训练和共识引导集成，改善多模态模型在平面几何中的图形理解与多步符号演绎。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 三个几何基准上的实验将准确率与采样量一并报告：CG-MTE 在测试时扩展下可达到高预算自一致性的相近准确率，并将采样成本最多降低 8 倍。
items.abstract_zh: 平面几何问题（PGP）求解已成为多模态推理的重要基准，因为它需要准确的视觉感知和精确的多步符号演绎。尽管测试时扩展（TTS）在一般数学推理中取得了显著成功，但在平面几何的符号程序范式下无法有效扩展。我们识别出两个关键障碍：刚性的符号程序带来的有限推理多样性，以及符号演绎前缺乏充分的显式视觉依据。为解决这些问题，我们提出 Multi-Trace Synthesis（MTS），将每个符号程序转化为异质推理轨迹，包括可执行 Python 脚本和 CoT 增强变体。我们进一步提出 Perception-Augmented（PA）训练，在演绎前将图形解析为结构化语义子句；并提出 Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble（CG-MTE），用于高效的自适应推理。在三个几何基准上的实验显示，我们的方法在不同模型规模上持续改善 PGP 求解，并相较通用 MLLM 和专用几何求解器均取得较强表现。在测试时扩展下，CG-MTE 能以最多降低 8 倍采样成本的方式，达到与高预算自一致性相近的准确率。代码和数据已公开，地址为 https://github.com/Jason8Kang/ReTTS-PGPS。

items.title: AutoCRAT: Within-trajectory Joint Control of Stochasticity and Compute for LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, which depends critically on inference-time decisions. Yet these decisions are commonly handled by static, one-size-fits-all policies, limiting adaptation to diverse tasks and reasoning stages. Recent adaptive methods partially address this limitation, but they primarily adapt either decoding stochasticity (how the model explores) or reasoning compute (how long the model reasons) in isolation, leaving their interaction within a single reasoning trajectory unmodeled. To address this challenge, we shift toward a within-trajectory joint control view, and instantiate it in AutoCRAT, a decoder-side controller for frozen backbones. Using only signals available during decoding, AutoCRAT jointly adjusts sampling stochasticity and reasoning budget during generation. AutoCRAT operates over a discrete action space and updates control decisions only at semantic boundaries, improving stability while remaining responsive to the evolving reasoning process. Comprehensive evaluation across 6 benchmarks demonstrates that AutoCRAT (I) uses 13.8-52.7% fewer inference tokens on average than recommended static configurations, (II) surpasses recommended static and adaptive baselines by 1.5-4.5% in relative accuracy, and (III) enjoys strong cross-backbone transferability.
items.summary_zh: AutoCRAT 在冻结骨干模型的解码过程中，联合调节采样随机性和推理计算量，并只在语义转换点更新控制决策。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 六项基准的报告同时给出准确率与 token 使用量：相较推荐静态配置，平均少用 13.8%–52.7% token，并取得 1.5%–4.5% 的相对准确率增益。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能够取得较强的推理表现，而这种表现关键取决于推理时的决策。然而，这些决策通常由静态、统一适用的策略处理，限制了对多样任务和不同推理阶段的适应。近期自适应方法部分缓解了这一问题，但它们主要单独适应解码随机性（模型如何探索）或推理计算量（模型推理多久），未对二者在单条推理轨迹中的交互进行建模。为解决这一挑战，我们转向轨迹内联合控制视角，并以面向冻结骨干模型的解码端控制器 AutoCRAT 实现这一视角。AutoCRAT 仅使用解码期间可获得的信号，在生成过程中联合调整采样随机性和推理预算。AutoCRAT 在离散动作空间中运行，并只在语义转换点更新控制决策，从而在保持对不断演化的推理过程响应性的同时提高稳定性。对六个基准的综合评估表明，AutoCRAT：（I）相较推荐的静态配置，平均少用 13.8%–52.7% 的推理 token；（II）相较推荐的静态和自适应基线取得 1.5%–4.5% 的相对准确率提升；（III）具有较强的跨骨干模型迁移性。

items.title: Agentic AI uncovers conserved cross-tissue protein co-abundance programs inaccessible to single-dataset analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Protein co-abundance clusters preserved across tissues can reveal shared disease mechanisms and candidate therapeutic targets, particularly when proteins implicated in organ-confined diseases converge in peripheral or accessible tissues. However, previous cross-tissue studies have focused on biologically pre-selected tissue pairs, leaving most possible combinations and non-obvious relationships unexplored. We present an LLM-agent framework for large-scale, evidence-grounded comparison of tissue-specific protein co-abundance networks. The framework constructs tissue networks, derives pairwise consensus clusters, and integrates evidence from expression atlases, protein interaction and complex databases, pathway annotations, disease catalogues, and literature. Applied to all 820 pairwise combinations of 41 human tissues and fluids, it identified 1,833 conserved co-abundance clusters across 406 tissue pairs. Colon, synovial fluid, blood, cerebrospinal fluid, and bone marrow were the most broadly connected tissues, while the most cluster-rich pairs were dominated by bone marrow. The analysis also highlighted non-obvious relationships: skin-bone marrow exceeded the anatomically adjacent bone-bone marrow pair, while colon-breast contained cancer-relevant clusters involving extracellular-matrix remodeling, lipid metabolism, and immune modulation. Cluster-level analyses generated further mechanistic hypotheses, including a brain-gut extracellular-vesicle/redox/serotonin-cofactor axis and a liver-bone marrow stress-response axis involving genes linked to white matter disease. These results provide a global, comparable landscape of conserved protein co-abundance and a hypothesis-generating resource for mechanistic and therapeutic exploration. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Gry1005/AgenticAI-conserved-cross-tissue-protein-co-abundance.
